Description:
Your Key Partner for Testing throughout the product life cycle! 

TAME-TEST offers comprehensive end-to-end test solutions dedicated to high reliable markets and critical applications for electronic-dominant systems, with a unique approach to testing, know-how and expertise. 
Our global offer encompasses : 
- Design and implementation of test and burn-in (Environmental Stress Screening) strategies 
- Design for Test (DfT) : structural, functional, system
- Development of manual and automatic Test Benches (Hardware & Software)
- Test data valorisation
- MRO of test equipment and resources (HW/SW)

You have a single point of contact for all stages of your project, from design to maintenance in operational conditions. 
Tame-Test has multidisciplinary technical teams both in France and Morocco. 

Tame-Test designs different types of test benches with different levels of automation:
Manual Test Benches 
Accessible due to their low cost, they require the continuous intervention of an operator, which makes them an interesting solution for small series or rapid tests involving low technicality.

Semi-Automatic Test Benches
Frequently used, these testers require the punctual intervention of operators and offer the best compromise between cost/performance/time. They are used for intermediate series and allow you to conduct both the simplest operations and the most complex ones.

Automatic Test Benches
Requiring a significant design effort, they allow for full automation of tests. They are ideal solutions for very large series or for long and complex tests, sometimes impossible to perform manually.

Mobile Testing Devices 
They can be used to carry out tests in buildings, outdoors or onboard cars, airplanes, ships, etc. and can be energy independent. These testing devices are designed to be mobile and to withstand the most extreme conditions of travel and use.

Our rugged products are designed for outdoor job site performance on major construction projects in all climates.

Sigicom is the first supplier to offer wireless, remote monitoring sensors. Our turnkey wireless solutions include the geophone sensors, data logger and modem, in a compact design with no cables. Sensors are pre-programmed with multiple national and international measurement standards. 
 
Through industry-leading customer service and partnership Sigicom has always enjoyed close relationships with its customers, creating innovative and simple solutions maximizing the benefit associated with collecting data remotely. The benefits and cost savings of remote monitoring compared to onsite manual data collection speaks for itself.
 
Sigicom operates according to the guidelines mandated by ISO 9001, and only uses components, designs, and manufacturing techniques that ensure the highest reliability.
 
Established in 1981, Sigicom’s headquarters is located in Stockholm, Sweden. We are a global company with offices in Sweden, Denmark, France, UK, USA, and Canada.

Name: KEMIWATT
Description:
Kemiwatt develops an innovative technology of redox flow batteries for the world market of stationary energy storage. A typical application is the storage of renewable energy (solar, wind), either off-grid for micro/mini-grid, or for grid services (load-shifting, peak-shaving, investment deferral...).

Because they store energy in liquids, redox flow batteries can store many hours of production at their rated power and have extremely long lifetimes (10+ years).

Kemiwatt's specific chemistry, with organic molecules in non-corrosive alkaline aqueous solutions, leads to a simple, robust system, that can work steadily for years with little maintenance.

- Secure meeting rooms (electromagnetic/acoustic) 
- Secure box, secure mobile enclosure (electromagnetic/acoustic)
 - Faradised pouches 
- Electronic Security Operations and Tempest zoning measurements
Founded in 1986 and based in La Trinité sur Mer from the outset, Siepel has been a secondary establishment of Cegelec Défense Toulouse, Vinci Energies Group, since September 2021. This takeover complements the group's existing range of high-performance systems for the cybersecurity of premises and networks. For Siepel, which keeps its historical activities, this integration brings a new dynamic as well as a complementary range and new business opportunities by relying on other operational units such as Cegelec Defence Mechatronic Solutions for positioners, Cegelec Defence Infrastructures & Réseaux for hardened infrastructures ....
Siepel has about 50 employees in R&D, design office, sales, manufacturing, procurement, installations.
Siepel's values are fully in line with those of the group: attention, support, safety, relational ethics, and many synergies are obvious: high added-value know-how, innovativeness, commitment to performance, respect for deadlines, networking to provide our clients with sustainable competitiveness.

Our design team has 100’s years combined experience in marine electronic systems and we take pride in our quality heritage with manufacturing in the UK and global reach with offices in the US and France. Last year our products were sold in over 100 countries worldwide.

Portés par nos équipes et notre expertise, nous accompagnons durablement les industriels en France et à l’international.

Labellisés French Fab, nous défendons une industrie française rigoureuse, engagée et solidement ancrée dans notre territoire.

La solution idéale pour équiper les bureaux, les commerces, les locaux

Une fois connecté à vos équipements (radiateur, chauffe-eau, ou tout autre équipement), il devient le cerveau de votre installation électrique. Délester, Piloter, Programmer : trois fonctions essentielles !
Délester : le délesteur intelligent peut couper les équipements avant que votre compteur principal ne disjoncte selon un ordre de priorité que vous définissez. Il permet aussi de visualiser vos pics de consommation sur une courbe.

Piloter : à tout moment, vous pouvez allumer ou éteindre les équipements connectés depuis votre téléphone ou votre ordinateur. Les radiateurs peuvent être pilotés à l’aide des sorties Fil Pilote si vous le souhaitez.

Programmer : Les fonctions de programmation du délesteur intelligent vous permettent de programmer des allumages et extinctions d’équipements selon un calendrier ou selon des événements (changement de période tarifaire par exemple). Vous pouvez aussi aller encore plus loin et programmer des changements d’ordre de priorité ou des changements d’ampérage maximal à ne pas dépasser.

Name: TDK
Description: TDK Corporation is a world leader in electronic solutions for the smart society based in Tokyo, Japan. Built on a foundation of material sciences mastery, TDK welcomes societal transformation by resolutely remaining at the forefront of technological evolution. It was established in 1935 to commercialize ferrite, a key material in electronic and magnetic products. TDK’s comprehensive, innovation-driven portfolio features passive components such as ceramic, aluminum electrolytic and film capacitors, as well as magnetics, high-frequency, and piezo and protection devices. The product spectrum also includes sensors and sensor systems such as temperature and pressure, magnetic, and MEMS sensors. In addition, TDK provides power supplies and energy devices, magnetic heads, software and more. These products are marketed under the product brands TDK, EPCOS, InvenSense, Micronas, Tronics, and TDK-Lambda. TDK focuses on demanding markets in automotive, industrial and consumer electronics, and information and communication technology. The company has a network of design and manufacturing locations and sales offices in Asia, Europe, and in North and South America. In fiscal 2025, TDK posted total sales of USD 14.4 billion and employed about 105,000 people worldwide.

We work closely with customers and partners in the European market and provide lighting solutions globally – with tailor-made solutions for our customers. 

The Fagerhult brand includes both the product company Fagerhults Belysning AB (based in Fagerhult, Sweden) and 12 sales companies located around Europe. Description:
Forsee Power is an industrial group specializing in smart battery systems for sustainable electric transport (light vehicles, off-highway vehicles, buses, trucks, and trains). 
A major player in Europe, Asia and North America, the Group designs, assembles, and supplies energy management systems based on cells that are among the most robust in the market and provides installation, commissioning, and maintenance on site and remotely. 
More than 4,000 buses and 140,000 LEV have been equipped with Forsee Power’s batteries. The Group also offers financing solutions (battery leasing) and second-life solutions for transport batteries. 
Forsee Power and its 850 employees are committed to sustainable development and the Group has obtained the Gold medal from leading sustainability rating agency EcoVadis. For more information: www.forseepower.com | @ForseePower

Name: PREMO Group
Description:
Global Leader in Innovative Magnetics enabling Technology for the 4th Industrial Revolution: RFID, NFC, Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, IoT, Electric Vehicles and M2M.

Name: Cicor Group
Description: Cicor is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced electronic solutions. Serving the healthcare technology, industrial electronics and aerospace & defence sectors, our full-cycle approach combines engineering excellence with high-precision production to bring ideas to life. Together with our customers, we create electronics that make the world a healthier, more connected and safer place.

Name: PULS Group
Description:
PULS is Europe’s biggest manufacturer of industrial DC power solutions and a global technology leader for reliable power supplies for demanding applications. Our solutions serve critical systems in factory and process automation, intralogistics, medical/life science, semiconductor industry, data centers, energy and automotive.

Since 1980, PULS has been driven by engineering excellence, innovation and customer value. We develop DC power solutions with superior reliability, highest efficiency and long-term operational security, helping customers reduce downtime, lower energy and maintenance costs and build reliable systems for years.

PULS has its roots in DIN rail power supplies, the area that shaped our company and laid the foundation for our success. Building on this expertise, we have grown into a global player with a broad portfolio. As a corporate group with Adelsystem and Wiferion, we offer a full DC power ecosystem: DIN rail power supplies, field power, DC backup solutions, wireless charging for AGVs and AMRs, and value-added services. This product universe opens new markets and application areas for industrial power solutions.

With around 1,400 employees worldwide, 350+ standard products, strong R&D capabilities and a resilient global production network, PULS supports customers and partners worldwide. We manufacture in Chomutov, Czech Republic, Suzhou, China, Chennai, India, and Germany.

As a self-financed, technology-driven company, PULS combines long-term thinking with a developer mindset. We value sustainability, quality and efficiency and empower customers to focus on performance, innovation and growth.

Contact: https://www.pulspower.com/contact/puls-worldwide/

Name: Mycronic
Description:
Mycronic has been a trusted partner to electronics and display manufacturers worldwide for more than 50 years. Today we are at the forefront of innovation in the SMT, semiconductor and automotive industries use our innovative products, services and solutions to create tomorrow’s electronics – from advanced displays to life-saving medical implants and the next generation of satellites. 

Although headquartered in Sweden, our four divisions: Pattern Generators, PCB Assembly Solutions, Assembly Solutions High Volume and Global Technologies makes us a global organization; with subsidiaries, agents and distributors in more than 50 countries. This enables us to combine deep market insight with fast, reliable support, helping our customers achieve efficient production. 

At Mycronic, diversity is more than a value — it’s our strength. Being a company built on passion, collaboration and outside-the-box thinking, a diverse workforce and inclusive culture fuels innovation and strengthens our connection to customers and the various in which we operate. Quite simply, our diversity is our competitive edge. 
Electronics touch every corner of our lives. Through our technological expertise, innovative spirit and passionate teamwork, we help make the world smarter, brighter and more sustainable, for people everywhere, every day. Together with our customers, we are committed to extending the frontiers of of electronics technology. Because with each breakthrough, the impossible becomes possible. Our mission is clear: to bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.

Name: WE-EF LIGHTING
Description: WE-EF is a global manufacturer of high-performance exterior luminaires renowned for outstanding engineering design and innovative optical systems. Established in 1950 in Germany, WE-EF is recognised worldwide as a leading exterior lighting specialist that provides professional lighting solutions for various applications, ranging from urban spaces to architectural projects.

Name: AHT Cooling Systems GmbH
Description: AHT is a leading company in commercial refrigeration supplying refrigeration units and systems with natural refrigerants. AHT refrigeration systems supply leading discount and supermarket chains as well as well-known manufacturers in the ice cream and beverage industry. With our headquarters in Rottenmann, Austria and production sites in China, Brazil and the USA, we are active on 4 continents worldwide. Under the umbrella of our parent company Daikin, we are part of a strong international group of companies that shares our values and ideas. A merger that will open up countless exciting career opportunities for you. You can look forward to a global working environment and attractive promotion and career change opportunities.

Name: JST transformateurs
Description:
JST transformateurs draws on over more than 50 years experience in design, manufacturing, and maintenance of electric transformers to meet the needs of its ever evolving clients across the five continents.

Our employees here at JST transformateurs maintain since the start a tradition of technical leadership.

Hence, JST transformateurs has helped Electricité de France (EDF) in the development of manufacturing and transportation of electricity in France, stimulating our engineers to think up innovative solutions in order to provide adapted responses to extremely demanding technical specifications. Until recently JST transformateurs was entrusted to design and manufacture transformers with an energy evacuation system for the new EPR technology nuclear power plant, currently under construction in Flamanville, France.

Concerning the railway network, this tradition is no weaker. JST transformateurs was the pioneering designer for the transformers that were onboard high-speed trains, during the development of the first TGV in partnership with Alstom and France’s national railway authority (the SNCF). JST transformateurs is still renowned for its very precise know-how which allows it to optimise the weight and the size of its products.

Conscientious of its social and environmental responsibility, JST transformateurs leads an independent strategy for sustainable development with the view of a long-term partnership with its clients and its suppliers.

Name: OMERIN Group
Description:
The OMERIN Group works every day to strengthen its position as global leader in the manufacturing of wires and cables that can withstand extremely  low and high temperatures (-190°C to +1400°C), and all types of wires and cables for severe environments. 

Rigour, know-how, innovation, and investments in human and material resources have been our leitmotiv since 1959 to continuously develop better products that meet the needs and requirements of our markets. The OMERIN Group boasts 1700 employees who work tirelessly each day to satisfy our customers.

The Group's current activities have been broken down into 4 Business Units concentrated on the Medical Device and Safety sectors:

•    Specialized Electrical Cables & Braided Sleevings
•    Medical and Pharmaceutical Devices
•    Flexible Heating Elements
•    Extruded Sleevings, Tubes and Hoses

Name: Tria
Description:
Tria gets your products to market faster, better and stronger with compute, system and HMI innovation.

Our mission is to help OEM customers build user interface solutions that meet the future demand of innovation and quality with reduced time to market utilizing our platform technologies and design & manufacturing capabilities.

Tria builds embedded compute, system and HMI solutions that meet the demand for innovation and quality, with reduced time to market, utilizing Tria’s platform technologies, design and manufacturing capabilities, and a world-class team of experts.

Name: COTHERM
Description:
COTHERM is an industrial group founded in 1948 in Grenoble (France), resolutely turned towards its customers. Its vocation is to design, manufacture and sell intelligent and connected temperature control systems and solutions.

It is an international company with subsidiaries in several countries. With its 700 employees worldwide, it generates 80% of its turnover through exports, in more than 60 countries over the 5 continents. 
Our international development is remarkable. For 70 years, our teams have developed technical solutions and processes integrating numerous technologies allowing us to offer our customers a wide range of robust products that equip today millions of water heaters, boilers and radiators over the world.

The new products and services that we develop bring efficient and innovative solutions that improve the comfort of the end user, with real energy savings. In this way, we are taking our part in the world of Smart Grid by sustainably preserving our resources & environment.

Cotherm has grown thanks to a vision & values. To perpetuate this success there are many challenges to be met:
•	Anticipating market changes to better support our customers' projects development
•	Mastering regulatory and environmental issues in an European & international context
•	Always be more innovative by integrating new technologies in our products
•	Improve our practices and organization to optimize our environmental impact and our employees' support

Name: BAUR GmbH
Description:
BAUR is the world market leader of testing and measurement technology. High grade products, onsite consultation and intensive training programs and comprehensive service from BAUR guarantee optimum status monitoring of electrical insulation materials and power supply systems. With this, the company makes significant contribution towards efficient and problem-free power supply around the globe.

BAUR is always one step ahead. Constant innovations in power generation and distribution demand quick adaptation of the measurement and testing technology. To meet these requirements, BAUR bets on maximum flexibility and continuous consolidation of its core competencies: Cable testing and fault location, diagnosis and evaluation of reliability of cable systems and dielectric insulation material tests. At BAUR, we have merged long years of experience and passion for technology with the ambition for continuous advanced technological development.

BAUR customers include power station companies, network operators, public utility companies as well as industrial and service companies around the world. Intensive contact with customers and consistent implementation of their expectations for technical solutions are given the highest priority at BAUR.

New knowledge that helps to ensure the flow: www.baur.eu/newsletter-registration

Name: Tamura Corporation
Description:
The company that would eventually become the Tamura Group came into being in 1924, one year before the start of radio broadcasting in Japan, as the Tamura Radio Store. Its main business was radio repair and the manufacture of original radios. In the process of pursuing superior sound, the firm came to handle the manufacture of the key component, the transformer.

Its reputation as the “Tamura of transformers” created a foundation on which to expand its businesses, including various electronic components related to transformers; flux and soldering materials that were born out of the pursuit of quality joining materials for the manufacture of transformers; soldering systems; and even broadcast audio equipment and communication systems, based on achievements in the manufacture of transformers for broadcasting and communication.

Currently, Tamura Corporation conducts business operations in three areas: electronic components, electronic chemical mounting, and information equipment, to develop and supply products that meet the needs of new markets, such as the environment and energy markets.

Tamura’s products have been supporting various industries and social infrastructure as “materials,” “components,” and “devices” that range from consumer products, such as automobiles and electronic equipment, to devices at manufacturing sites and natural-energy-related and aerospace fields. From raw materials to complete systems, Tamura’s technologies have contributed to safety and comfort as well as energy savings.

With the aim of continuously providing safe and secure high-quality products and services that satisfy customers from all over the world, the Tamura Group has been working on resolving social issues by promoting business activities while taking social and environmental impacts into account in all processes ranging from R&D, procurement, and production to sales.

Name: SEDIVER
Description:
For 75 years Sediver has specialized in overhead line insulation technology - research, design, manufacturing, testing and supply of insulators for AC and DC applications designed to perform under all kind of environmental conditions.

Through strong R&D investment, Sediver has kept on pioneering solutions to answer technical challenges and environment constraints.
Sediver quality of products is confirmed by outstanding track record and over than 600 million toughened glass insulators in 150 countries.

HVAC applications - Sediver toughened glass insulator

Name: Unex Group
Description:
• Keeping you safer •
We manufacture innovative insulating cable management systems for electrical, telecommunications and HVAC installations.
We work to guarantee a safer, more humane and more sustainable world.
As the technological benchmark in our specialty, we control the entire production process from the formulation of raw materials to the design, manufacture, distribution and technical promotion by our own team of sales engineers.
Our daily proximity with our clients, together with 50 years of experience in the electrical sector and the participation in various international regulatory committees have enabled us to discover the market needs and adjust to its requirements, offering a complete range of products with enhanced technical features compared to market standards, and endorsed by the most prestigious quality marks of International scope: UL, VDE, NF, N, GOST...

- Respect for the environment: Unex is aware of the global pledge that sustainability implies. This is why we perform all our industrial and commercial activities through the sustainable use of natural resources, the efficient use of energy and a full respect for the environment and society.
-International expansion: Thanks to our long-term vision, we focused on opening new horizons with a clear vocation for world-wide expansion.
The quickness and reliability of our deliveries are assured by a complete stock of all our products in our logistic centres of Barcelona and Santiago de Chile. Our sales offices in Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Portugal and Chile and our multicultural team, make us proud and encourage us to place our solutions on all five continents.

Name: GeoMax Positioning
Description:
As a part of (*)Hexagon, GeoMax Positioning benefits from industry-leading technological expertise. This allows us to provide a comprehensive portfolio of unmatched, integrated intuitive solutions, along with flexible hands-on support for surveying and construction professionals around the world. Our systems include easy-to-use, highly productive total stations, GNSS instruments, unique software, rotating and layout lasers, optical and digital levels, and accessories. Our portfolio is known for robustness, ease of use and outstanding software designed by and for users in construction and surveying. From our base in Europe, our technology is supported by a broad sales, support and service network covering all continents.

Description: At CIXI Active Mobility, we aim to transform the 'passive' journeys of our busy days into moments of conscious effort for a more active and healthy lifestyle. Notre entreprise

Description: WAGO compte parmi les prestataires internationaux novateurs dans la technologie de raccordement électrique et de technique d'automatisation. Name: ewo
Description:
ewo's mission goes far beyond offering maximum functionality and modularity, outstanding quality and design. “empowering wellbeing outdoors” means focusing on the community-forming and evocative aspects of light. Based on this central idea, ewo has become one of the leading innovators in the industry with cutting-edge and customized solutions that superbly combine three principles:

MASTERING THE SHAPE OF LIGHT: The shape of light and its atmospheric effect in public spaces is individually designed through the modular use of optics developed in-house. Light is used exactly where it is needed.

MASTERING THE BODY OF LIGHT: High-precision craftsmanship, durability, and efficiency characterize ewo luminaires. ewoIndividual allows for the creation of systems beyond the standard portfolio to fulfill individual requirements in terms of shape, color, and surface.  

MASTERING THE INTELLIGENCE OF LIGHT: The ewo-owned brand connexx enables intelligent lighting control. By developing hardware and software for luminaire control, connexx offers a wealth of holistic, sustainable solutions.    

Industries and areas such as architecture and arts, public space, roads and traffic, airports and logistics and sports benefit from using ewo products and solutions.  
 
From the company headquarters in Cortaccia in South Tyrol, Italy, and its branches in Germany, Austria, France, and the USA, ewo carries its lighting philosophy into the world with over 130 employees. “empowering wellbeing outdoors”—since 1996.

Enlaps is the only native digital imaging solution, which combines hardware and software, as it integrates capturing images and generating content. Enlaps’ technology is used for remote project monitoring, as much for tourism, as for events industry, real estate or research : the Tikee camera, rendered autonomous by solar energy, is 4G connected to the SaaS myTikee platform, which allows to capture, edit, analyze and share images. 

Today, more than 7 000 cameras allow 3 000 European and American companies to tell their stories, generating an emotion that is translated in images thanks to the information collected remotely and in real time.

We are driven to create top quality, cutting-edge motors that are increasingly efficient in performance and design, while paying close attention to environmental considerations.

  Fabrication services

 Design tools

Machine distribution:

Applications include biophotonics, instrumentation, remote sensing, as well as  micro-machining and marking.  We continually introduce novel performance for OEM customers and scientific institutions. Our picolasers have been shipping for over ten years, with thousands operating in the field, and MTTFs exceeding 2.000.000 hours.

The ioNext technology also allow functions such as splitters, couplers, Taps, Mux/Demux, polarizers and custom devices.

Notre savoir-faire : réaliser les fonctions électroniques les plus complexes pour environnements sévères

Nos ingénieurs conçoivent des solutions adaptées aux cahiers des charges client : alimentations, convertisseurs, chargeurs, drivers moteurs, cartes process, calculateurs et solutions d’interface homme-machine. Ils re-designent aussi, des systèmes existants pour assurer la vie-produit ou améliorer les performances techniques tout en réduisant les coûts (optimisation de la topologie et des composants, etc.).

Nos activités dans le médical représentent aujourd’hui 40% de notre chiffre d’affaires, un secteur aux besoins en innovation et aux exigences normatives très élevés.  Nos clients historiques sont des grands comptes de la marine civile et militaire avec plus de 100 000 unités vendues, dont nos très robustes modèles DOLPHIN PRO HD+ certifiés DNV-GL.

Notre offre technologique tout-en-un (HW/SW/CEM), nos taux de fiabilité exemplaires en fabrication, OTD et prix sont nos principaux leviers de fidélisation.

La solidité d’un groupe international. En 2015, CATS POWER DESIGN a rejoint le groupe international Eight Lakes. Notre présence dans ce groupe solide et financièrement indépendant (notation AAA) nous permet de nous développer à un rythme soutenu. Depuis les années 1970, Eight Lakes est un fournisseur reconnu de produits et solutions électroniques et mécatroniques pour les marchés industriel et professionnel. Le Groupe emploie plus de 200 collaborateurs en France, Belgique, aux Pays-Bas et à Taïwan. Son chiffre d’affaires était de 80 millions EUR en 2017. 

Pour en savoir plus: www.catspowerdesign.com

Name: Véritable
Description:
Véritable est une société française leader en agriculture urbaine d’intérieur. 
Nous proposons des potagers intelligents pour permettre à chacun de cultiver simplement, un très large choix de plantes comestibles directement dans sa cuisine. A la clé, des herbes aromatiques, des fleurs comestibles, des jeunes pousses et des mini légumes toujours frais et sains à portée de main pour tous.

Vous n’avez pas la main verte ? Les solutions Véritable se composent d’une gamme de potagers d’intérieur autonomes et de Lingots : des recharges d’aromates prêtes à l’emploi. 
Arrosage, lumière, nutriments... Tout a été pensé pour permettre de cultiver en toute simplicité dans un petit espace de façon ultra simple. Vous n’avez plus qu’à profiter de vos récoltes pour sublimer vos plats.

Redécouvrez les vraies saveurs

Fabrication française
Véritable est engagé dans son écosystème socio-économique. Basée en Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes près de Lyon, l’entreprise fabrique 90% de ses produits dans un rayon de 200km. Les activités de recherche et développement, conception produits, commercialisation et services clients sont assurées en interne. Les activités industrielles de fabrication, assemblage et logistique sont assurées par des partenaires français de confiance. En tout, près de 20 partenaires sont impliqués, cela représente plus de 300 emplois en France.

Name: RITTAL FR
Description:
Avec une production journalière de 15 000 coffrets et armoires électriques au travers de ses 11 sites de productions sur 3 continents, Rittal est le leader mondial des solutions d’armoires et de coffrets pour l’industrie,  et d’infrastructure globale pour les salles informatiques et les datacenters. C’est aussi un précurseur de l’industrie 4.0 dans le domaine des armoires électriques.
Rittal SAS est la filiale Française du groupe Rittal crée en 1961 et dont le siège est basé en Allemagne. Rittal est la principale entité du groupe familial Friedhelm Loh, qui est l’une des représentations phares du Mittelstand allemand. L’effectif dans le monde atteint 11 500 personnes et a réalisé en 2014 un chiffre d’affaires de 2.2 milliards d’euros.
Nos clients cherchent de plus en plus à gagner en Time to Market et en standardisation ce qui leur permet de développer leurs propres valeur ajoutée autour du besoin de leurs clients et non de la conception en interne de solutions qui ne sont plus dans leur cœur de métier.
Connaissance des besoins, gain de temps, standardisation et qualité reconnue sont les constantes de l’offre Rittal. Avec plus de 1 500 brevets déposés dans le monde, la force de Rittal est d’innover constamment afin de développer des armoires électriques et des solutions d’infrastructures informatiques qui définissent des standards industriels. Cette standardisation permet de développer des plateformes qui conviennent à de multiples applications, une gamme très vaste d’accessoires pour une flexibilité totale, une qualité éprouvée pour des exigences de  marchés internationaux de plus en plus exigeants.
En parallèle, Rittal s’appuie sur l’aide de sa société-sœur Eplan, qui commercialise des logiciels de solutions d’ingénieries électriques et mécatroniques, et de Rittal Automation System, qui invente des concepts d’automatisation des TGBT, pour offrir un concept unique de conception et de fabrication entièrement digitalisée pour la mise en place de l’industrie 4.0.

Description:
ASICA est spécialisé dans la conception et la fabrication de cartes, sous-ensembles et ensembles électroniques.

Le secret de la réussite d’ASICA est basé sur un savoir-faire reconnu depuis plus de 30 ans et sur une écoute active des besoins de ses clients. Son objectif est d'être à leurs côtés tout au long du projet en développant un fort partenariat.

Le partenariat qui anime ASICA permet d'aborder des projets avec des donneurs également dans le cadre de projets collaboratifs.

Name: Pyrocontrole - Chauvin Arnoux Group
Description:
Pyrocontrole est un acteur majeur du marché de la mesure de température en France et à l’international en milieu industriel sévère (chimie, hydrogène et nucléaire).

Depuis 1945 Pyrocontrole développe des produits à forte technicité dédiés aux industries de pointe telles que l’industrie Nucléaire, la Chimie, la Pétrochimie, l’Hydrogène ou encore la Métallurgie. La grande majorité de l’activité est consacrée à l’élaboration de cahiers des charges précis, de qualification de capteurs de température et de fabrication de sondes de très hautes températures (jusqu’à 1 800°C) et hautes pressions (jusqu’à 4700bars). 

Pyrocontrole propose également des équipements de régulation tels que des régulateurs de température, des régulateurs de puissance électrique, des enregistreurs sans papier et des Interfaces Hommes Machines associés à des Modules E/S.

Ses expertises sont reconnues en France et se sont exportées à l’international depuis le rachat de la société en 1997 par le groupe Chauvin Arnoux. 
Le « service Pyrocontrole » c’est une équipe disponible, dynamique, capable de trouver des solutions adaptées à tout type de problématique de mesure thermique. C’est également une organisation Qualité performante et qui œuvre quotidiennement, notamment dans les domaines très exigeants du Nucléaire et de l’Hydrogène. 

Pyrocontrole dispose de son propre laboratoire de métrologie accrédité COFRAC pour garantir les performances des produits livrés. Partenaire de toutes les entreprises industrielles du CAC40, Pyrocontrole saura vous accompagner dans vos projets pour vous proposer la meilleure solution.

Description:
ACOFASE a été créé en 2006 par Christophe BOIDE et est implanté en Savoie.
Tout d’abord, d’où vient le nom « ACOFASE » ? C’est tout simplement l’acronyme d’Alarme, Courant Faible et Sécurité.
Durant ses premières années, l’entreprise était spécialisée dans la fourniture, la pose, le dépannage et la maintenance de système de sécurité, d’installation domotique, d’automatisme, d’électricité générale.
Au 1er octobre 2024, Christophe a vendu le fonds de son entreprise à son technicien Maxime Villard. Ainsi, Maxime décide de prioriser les domaines d’activités suivants :
- Les portails/portes de garage/barrières levantes et les automatismes (l’entreprise est agréée FAAC) ;
- La sécurité des particuliers et des professionnels avec les alarmes (vol et incendie), la vidéo protection, les générateurs de brouillard, l’interphonie et le contrôle d’accès.
Nos services s’adressent donc aux particuliers et aux professionnels se situant en Rhône-Alpes. Nous travaillons avec de grandes marques reconnues dans leurs domaines pour vous apporter robustesse et fiabilité. Nous proposons du matériel de qualité professionnelle à des prix abordables. Name: Sigicom Canada, Inc.
Description:
Since its humble origins over four decades ago, Sigicom has grown to become a leading supplier and manufacturer of robust remote monitoring solutions. We develop autonomous and innovative measuring equipment for vibration, noise, and geotech with accompanying cloud software for presentation and reporting. Our rugged products are designed for outdoor job site performance on major construction projects in all climates.  
 
We focus on providing cost-effective equipment for remote monitoring of vibration, noise and geotech disturbances due to construction work. 
 
INFRA Net is Sigicom’s highly innovative and user-friendly internet-based system for project administration, data analysis, reporting, and web presentation of monitoring data. Our data loggers come integrated with modems and receive data from digital sensors which are then sent to servers for presentation on the INFRA Net web portal. 
 
With INFRA Net you can view real-time data and information online. Users can also remotely control and configure deployed sensors without having to be at the job site.
 
Sigicom is the first supplier to offer wireless, remote monitoring sensors. Our turnkey wireless solutions include the geophone sensors, data logger and modem, in a compact design with no cables. Sensors are pre-programmed with multiple national and international measurement standards. 
 
Through industry-leading customer service and partnership Sigicom has always enjoyed close relationships with its customers, creating innovative and simple solutions maximizing the benefit associated with collecting data remotely. The benefits and cost savings of remote monitoring compared to onsite manual data collection speaks for itself.
 
Established in 1981, Sigicom’s headquarters is located in Stockholm, Sweden. We are a global company with offices in Sweden, France, UK, USA, and Canada.
 
For more information, contact us or visit our website: www.sigicom.com

Name: TAPIR Power modules
Description:
TAPIR Power modules develops power modules from elementary switching cells with integrated bifacial air cooling.
Thanks to its modular nature,  our solution facilitates the design of power modules and offers great freedom of arrangement and connection of switching cells. It also contributes to the lightening of the power converters by optimization of the cooling by the distribution of the heat sources in the volume of the heat sink. Thus, we obtain a bifacial cooling directly from the heat sources without interfaces as in conventional modules. The integration of a capacitor as close as possible to the transitors improves the dynamic behavior of the switching cell and makes it perfectly suited to large gap SiC components.
TAPIR Solution is incubated in G2ELAB laboratory and funded by SATT Linksium.

Description:
Backer est le premier fournisseur de solutions dans les domaines des éléments chauffants électriques, de la mesure et du contrôle pour des entreprises de premier plan de différents secteurs.

Notre fondateur Christian Backer a breveté l’élément chauffant tubulaire moderne en 1921. Près de 30 ans plus tard, à Sösdala, en Suède, Backer AB est fondé pour commercialiser cette technologie avec une production à grande échelle.

L’entreprise Backer moderne est le partenaire industriel technique des plus importantes entreprises de plusieurs secteurs industriels. Nous fournissons des solutions compétitives dans les domaines de la mesure, du chauffage et du contrôle pour des entreprises de premier plan du secteur de l’automobile, de l’énergie, du rail, de la technologie médicale, du HVAC et des process. Nos clients demandent des solutions techniques innovantes et personnalisées, adaptées à leurs applications spécifiques.
 
Chez Backer, nous déployons tous les efforts nécessaires pour contribuer à créer des avantages compétitifs pour nos clients en ajoutant de la valeur ajoutée par le biais de partenariats. Notre approche de la conception et de la fourniture de produits apporte de réels avantages à nos clients. Grâce à notre présence mondiale, nos clients savent qu’ils peuvent compter sur les services d’ingénierie et de support Backer où qu’ils conçoivent, testent ou produisent leurs produits.
 
Backer s’efforce de fournir des solutions techniques optimales, avec la meilleure qualité possible et des prix globalement compétitifs.

Name: SOUND4
Description:
Delivering the best at all times is not an easy task but the team of SOUND4 makes it seem effortless thanks to over 30 solid years of experience in the field. What we excel at, above everything else, is audio signal processing. Launched back in 2007, SOUND4 began with analog technologies and went on to achieve groundbreaking results in the digital world as well, having an instant impact on the market with a string of innovative products. The launch of a set of FM/HD processing tools was quickly followed by the release of networking audio-over-IP solutions.

2010 was significant in the company’s illustrious history as SOUND4’s very first multichannel voice processor was introduced on the market and the company integrated the Livewire Audio IP standard, which most of our equipment today is compatible with. This revolutionary product immediately received the acknowledgement of the industry in the form of two prestigious prizes – The 2010 Innovation Trophy in Paris and the Pick Hit Award at the 2012 NAB Show in Las Vegas. Further recognition came in 2012 with the release of our Web Radio product range which received a Cool Stuff Award upon its presentation at NAB 2012.

Today, SOUND4 is a household name in the competitive, fast-developing world of broadcasting technology and enjoys a deserved reputation for proven quality and reliable service.

All SOUND4 products are developed and produced in accordance with the latest ISO 9001 quality control standards.

Shelyak supports astronomers, observatories, universities, astronomy clubs and educators with reliable, precise and accessible instruments adapted to scientific, educational and technical needs worldwide We adapt products and develop custom instruments for specific technical requirements and scientific projects.

Shelyak Instruments conçoit, fabrique et distribue des instruments de spectroscopie astronomique pour la recherche, l'enseignement, l'industrie et l'astronomie amateur. Notre gamme comprend des spectroscopes, spectrographes, caméras astronomiques, fentes spectroscopiques, fibres optiques, modules de guidage, modules d'étalonnage, réseaux de diffraction, logiciels et accessoires. Elle inclut notamment Alpy 600, Alpy 200, UVEX, Lhires III, LISA, eShel, Whoppshel, Sol'Ex, Star'Ex, Star Analyser, TimeBox, SPOX et Demetra. Nos solutions permettent d'observer, acquérir, calibrer, traiter et analyser les spectres des étoiles, du Soleil, des nébuleuses, galaxies, comètes, novae, supernovae et quasars. Shelyak accompagne astronomes, observatoires, universités, clubs et enseignants avec des instruments fiables, précis, accessibles et adaptés aux besoins scientifiques, pédagogiques et techniques, partout dans le monde, depuis 20 ans, déjà.

UNE TECHNOLOGIE ÉPROUVÉE

La diode électroluminescente ou LED (de l’anglais light emitting diode) est un composant optoélectronique apparu au début des années 60. Dès lors, la technologie n’a cessé de se démocratiser et d’envahir les objets du quotidien : feux tricolores, rétroéclairage des écrans LCD, éclairage pour automobile ... Les années 2000 marquent un tournant technologique dans le domaine de l’éclairage général avec l’apparition de LED à forte puissance.


LA LED VERSION LUMENCO

Afin de vous proposer le meilleur de la technologie LED, LUMENCO a consacré près de quatre ans à sélectionner ses fournisseurs et partenaires. Nous avons choisi les leaders mondiaux de la fabrication de LED, pour produire les composants de nos solutions d’éclairage. En collaboration avec nos ingénieurs, nous avons mis au point le produit de substitution idéal au tube fluorescent : le tube LED 495. Soyez serein  nous nous occupons de tout.

Name: PARIS GANG DESIGN
Description:
Né en 2005 à la croisée du design et de la communication, Paris Gang Design fabrique et distribue sa propre marque d'interrupteurs et prises haut de gamme.
Dans sa forme, le design de nos interrupteurs reprend les codes des boutons ‘années 30’, et honore la précision des lignes et des matières, entre Luxe et Sobriété.
Sans vis apparentes nos interrupteurs et prises sont déclinés dans des finitions tels que les Inox : brossé, miroir ; Altuglass : transparent, Opaline ; les Laitons : poli, brossé, vieilli, brûlé ; les Bronze : Ancien, Médaille ;  Argent vieilli, Cuivre vieilli, Plaqué Or, Plaqué Or Rose etc.
Dans un esprit joaillerie, l’interrupteur Paris Gang s’impose comme le détail qui fait la différence. Paris Gang utilise des matériaux européens qui pour certains sont issus d'une tradition de fabrication de plus de 100 ans. Les artisans sélectionnés pour la fabrication de nos produits sont basés en Haute-Savoie et Savoie, ainsi qu'en Normandie.
Notre "camp de base" se trouve à Annecy en Haute -Savoie, aux pieds des Alpes, c'est de là que nous pilotons la fabrication et la distribution de nos produits. Nos clients Architectes, Architectes d'intérieur, Décorateurs, sont principalement Français et prescrivent nos produits pour des chantiers en France et à l'étranger.
Nos Interrupteurs et Prises sont sélectionnés pour des projets de rénovation ou de neuf, pour des Particuliers, des Boutiques et pour l'Hôtellerie. Nous avons depuis 2007 fourni l'appareillage de nombreux hôtels en France, en Italie et en Suisse. 
Le renouvellement de la confiance de nos clients depuis 2005 pour des projets aussi nombreux que variés est notre meilleur fondement.

Name: KiloTek
Description:
Chef Assist est une balance conçue pour éliminer les pertes liées aux erreurs de recettes en production professionnelle.

Dans les métiers de bouche et l’industrie alimentaire, un oubli d’ingrédient, un mauvais pesage ou une étape sautée peuvent entraîner des pertes importantes. KiloTek agit directement sur un problème souvent sous-estimé : les pertes invisibles dues aux oublis, à la routine et à la variabilité humaine.

Les recettes sont créées via smartphone ou ordinateur (Wi-Fi). Chaque recette est découpée en étapes précises et personnalisables, intégrant l’ensemble du process de fabrication, pas uniquement le pesage.

Les étapes peuvent inclure, à titre d’exemples : pesage, mise au batteur, temps de repos, contrôles intermédiaires, mise au four avec minuteur intégré, et bien d’autres selon la méthode de production.

Il est impossible de passer à l’étape suivante sans avoir validé la précédente.
Ce fonctionnement empêche mécaniquement les oublis et sécurise l’exécution des recettes, même en cas de forte cadence ou de rotation d’équipe.

Résultat :
	•	moins d’erreurs
	•	moins de pertes
	•	plus de régularité
	•	plus de marge

Chef Assist : moins d’erreurs, plus de profit.

EMCtronic intègre toutes les phases du développement de produits ou de sous-ensembles, de la définition du cahier des charges, l'étude, la conception mécanique et électrique, la programmation ainsi que les réalisations de prototypes ou de petites séries.

Nos compétences sont reconnues dans des domaines variés comme l'industrie, la distribution d'énergie, l'électronique médicale ou de mesure. 

Nous avons su allier depuis notre création, des développements de produits pour nos clients, mais aussi des savoir-faire qui nous ont placé comme un acteur important sur le marché des sous-ensembles de puissance spécifiques.

Nous intervenons sur tous types de projets:
- commutation de puissance rapide, 
- convertisseurs de puissance faible bruit intégrés à des appareils de mesure,
- alimentations AC programmables très faible bruit
- électronique de mesure
- tests spécifiques
- switchs électroniques haute tension ou forts courants
- générateurs de courant régulés pour le test de composants (relais, semiconducteurs, ...)

Name: TRILUX
Description: TRILUX - Simplify Your Light stands for the simplest way to intelligent, individual light. For more than 100 years TRILUX has been inspiring its customers with high-quality and individual lighting solutions - because light is our passion. This includes not only innovative luminaires but also perfectly matched lighting solutions for offices, industry, healthcare, education, retail and sports. At TRILUX we know that the perfect luminaire alone is not enough. TRILUX focuses on people and contributes with its solutions to a sustainable, healthy and connected world. Because where there is light, there is life.

Name: LAPP Group
Description:
Headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany, LAPP is a leading supplier of integrated solutions and branded products in the field of cable and connection technology. The company's portfolio includes standard and highly flexible cables, industrial connectors and screw technology, customised system solutions, automation technology and robotics solutions for the intelligent factory of the future, as well as technical accessories. LAPP's core market is the industrial machinery and plant engineering sector. Other key markets are in the food industry, logistics, as well as the energy and the mobility sector.

The company was founded in 1959 and is still fully family-owned today. In the fiscal year 2025, it generated consolidated sales of EUR 1.93 billion. LAPP employs around 5,700 people worldwide, manufactures at 27 international locations and is active in a total of over 80 countries worldwide.

Name: IPG Photonics
Description: IPG Photonics is the world leader in fiber laser technology, offering solutions for applications across a wide array of industries. Headquartered in Marlborough, USA, the company has developed a robust, vertically integrated supply chain, developing key technology components in-house, thus enabling the most reliable, powerful, and efficient laser solutions. With over 30 locations across the globe, we are committed to developing innovative products that provide reliable, cost-effective solutions for our customers’ needs.

Name: Delta Dore Group
Description:
At Delta Dore, we follow our convictions by charting our own course, with the determination to involve everyone around us in the energy transition. 

Since 1970, this desire has forged our expertise in energy management, then in connected housing. We put our technology, made in France & Germany, to work for people, enabling them to reduce their energy consumption and impact, without sacrificing their comfort. 

Our 820 European employees are seeking to transform lifestyles, by giving everyone the means to commit to positive sobriety: a world in which optimising energy goes hand in hand with living better. 

Join us and let's rise to the challenge of positive sobriety together!

Name: PRUFTECHNIK Group
Description:
PRUFTECHNIK is a global maintenance technology supplier with a wide product, service and training range tailored to the needs of the maintenance professionals in the areas of shaft alignment, vibration analysis, condition monitoring and nondestructive testing. Many manufacturing organizations worldwide trust in our solutions for the reliability and condition-based maintenance of rotating machinery.

Founded in 1972 by the inventor of modern laser shaft alignment, PRUFTECHNIK is the world leader in precision shaft alignment. intelliSWEEP, Live Move or Live Trend are just a few of the top shaft alignment features developed by PRUFTECHNIK and used every day by alignment specialists around the world to deliver best-in-class alignment jobs. 

Our award-winning systems ROTALIGN, OPTALIGN, PARALIGN or VIBXPERT are built on state-of-the art technology to fulfill the highest requirements in precision and usability. Our latest product addition SONOCHEK rounds up our offline condition monitoring portfolio with uncompromising ultrasound testing capabilities.
With an extended network of subsidiaries and distributors in more than 70 countries, we serve manufacturing organizations locally, all around the world.

On our LinkedIn channel, you will find daily product news, event and training notifications as well as expert knowledge all around alignment, condition monitoring, and nondestructive testing. For a more targeted content delivery, our special focus pages offer the same content filtered out more specifically for alignment, vibration or nondestructive testing professionals.

Please don’t hesitate to leave us a comment, or contact us via our website www.pruftechnik.com. Your local PRUFTECHNIK team will be very happy to help you out.

Name: Zurich Instruments
Description:
Zurich Instruments develops and manufactures advanced products for Quantum Computing and Periodic Signal Measurement. Based in Zurich, Switzerland, with subsidiaries and offices in Germany, Japan, USA, South Korea, France, and China, we are committed to providing high-quality instrumentation and direct support to our international customers, scientists, and technologists who are dedicated to measuring complex phenomena using our instruments.

Our product range includes:

- Quantum computing control systems
- Lock-in amplifiers
- Arbitrary waveform generators
- Impedance analyzers
- Phase-locked loops
- Digitizers
- Boxcar averagers

Our team comprises individuals who are passionate about technology and work together with a collaborative and innovative approach. As part of the Rohde & Schwarz family, we are a high-end instrumentation company with steady growth and we're always looking for talented individuals who thrive on challenges and want to shape the future of technology alongside us!

Name: BaByliss
Description:
For more than 50 years the pioneering brand BaByliss Paris is by your side in everyday life to strengthen your style by offering you beauty tips of professional quality.

The story of BaByliss started in the early 1960s with the launch of the first curling iron developed by hairdressers René Lelièvre and Roger Lemoine in the back of a small hairdressing salon in Montmartre.
Since then BaByliss has been reinventing itself day after day with a varied range that meets the needs of today's women and men.

European leader in hairdressing
600 employees around the world
Present in 61 countries including 12 subsidiaries
4 research & development centers
+ 4 million clippers sold per year
+ 2.5 million hair dryers sold per year
+ 5.5 million styling devices sold per year
80% of French households own at least 1 BaByliss product

Name: IPG Photonics GmbH & Co. KG
Description:
IPG Photonics is the leading developer and manufacturer of high-performance fiber lasers and amplifiers for diverse applications in numerous markets. IPG Photonics diverse lines of low, medium and high-power lasers and amplifiers are used in materials processing, entertainment, medical, biotechnology, scientific and advanced applications. Our products are displacing traditional technologies in many current applications and enabling new applications for lasers.

The Company is leveraging its brand and position as a pioneer and leader in developing and commercializing fiber lasers and amplifiers increasing its market share in the broader markets. IPG lasers continue to displace traditional lasers in many existing applications due to their superior performance and value. Quite simply, IPG's products are disrupting the market by empowering tomorrow's applications today.

IPG's highly vertically-integrated development and manufacturing capabilities enable the Company to meet customer requirements, accelerate development, manage costs and improve component yields, while maintaining high performance and quality standards. 

IPG is a global company with manufacturing facilities in the U.S., Germany, Russia and Italy, and regional sales offices in China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, India, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, Spain, Poland, Czech Republic, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The Company sells its products globally to OEMs, system integrators and end users in a wide range of diverse markets that have the in-house engineering capability to integrate IPG's products into their own systems.

Name: SCHURTER Group
Description:
The SCHURTER Group is a globally successful Swiss technology company. With our components ensuring the clean and safe supply of power, input systems for easeof use and sophisticated overall solutions, we impress our customers with agility and excellent product and service quality. 

As a leading innovator, SCHURTER manufactures and distributes components for circuit protection, as well as connectors, switches and EMC products. In close cooperation with the customers, input systems are developed and manufactured. SCHURTER also offers services for the electronics industry in the field of printed circuit board assembly. The business unit Solutions coordinates complete solutions from project planning to the manufacture of end products.

22 companies in 17 countries belong to the SCHURTER Group, 11 companies of which have their own production sites. This ensures that all major markets can be served by their own companies. They are coordinated from three hubs: SCHURTER AG in Lucerne for Europe, SCHURTER Inc. in Santa Rosa for America as well as SCHURTER (S) Pte. Ltd. in Singapore for Asia. In addition, SCHURTER has representatives in about 60 countries and works together with over 200 distributors. This close-knit network guarantees that SCHURTER products are securely and quickly available internationally.

Name: AVIRE
Description:
AVIRE delivers an extensive range of safety and communication products for lifts including light curtains, emergency telephones, connectivity solutions and displays. AVIRE products are installed in over four million buildings worldwide and are made up of market leading brands each with their own unique histories and specialties. A large part of our strength comes from our product brands (MEMCO, MICROKEY, RATH, and JANUS) each of which brings a wealth of knowledge and innovative technology to the table.

With manufacturing locations in Barcelona, the Czech Republic, and USA and sales offices in 7 locations across the globe; we believe that our global sales with local support approach gives our customers the high-quality product and hassle-free experience to easily maintain and modernize their lifts.

We are committed to providing quality products and solutions. With a dedicated focus on investing in our current portfolio we are also continuously looking to the future and listening to our customer’s needs in an ever-changing world.

Name: STEINEL
Description:
STEINEL is an electrical and electronic manufacturing company with Headquarters based in Germany (Herzebrock-Clarholz). The company employs 1,500 persons and is a worldwide leading company for Intelligent Lighting, Sensor Technology and also Tools for Professional use.
 
Products are developed in Germany and manufactured in Europe. They are sold all over the world, through subsidiaries (France, USA, UK, Italy, Romania...) or distribution partners. Dedicated products ranges are available in PROFESSIONAL and DIY channels.

STEINEL is also known as the inventor of the SensorLight and pioneer of high-frequency technology for use in Professional lighting automation. STEINEL was the first manufacturer to use HF-technology for detecting movements in spaces and buildings and invisibly integrate it in lights.

The intelligent solutions from STEINEL are the no. 1 choice for architects, lighting planners, electrical fitters and consultant all over the world.

Name: Power-Sonic
Description:
Power is an essential part of our everyday life. We all rely on power to keeps us safe, connected and on the move. The demand for power is increasing globally and that is one of the reasons why Power-Sonic is committed to providing quality, efficient and cost effective power solutions.

Power-Sonic has been a leading force within the battery storage industry for over 55 years, providing an innovative range of battery and power storage solutions.

Our range of batteries are designed and manufactured using the latest technology and state-of-the-art equipment to ensure that they met the unique demands of each application. Our range includes sealed lead acid (SLA) and lithium iron phosphate technologies (LiFePO4), chargers and related accessories.

Our battery products can be found in industries and applications in over 70 countries worldwide. Power-Sonic utilizes a worldwide distribution network with distribution hubs in Reno, NV (USA), London (UK) and Paris (France).

As well as supplying an innovative range of battery products we also provide complete power storage solutions to help solve some of the power challenges our customers have to face.

Our knowledge, experience and commitment enables us to find the best solutions available. Our strength lies in our customer focused approach to find the solution together. By working together we can find the right solution and help exceed customer expectations.

Our commitment to provide quality, efficient and cost effective power solutions, with a customer focused approach to service, sets us apart from the competition.

Our mission – To deliver battery solutions globally, through the supply of the highest quality technologies, at the fairest price allied with outstanding service.

For more information please visit our website

Name: Axon' Cable Group
Description:
For over 60 years, the success of the Axon' Group has been based on its ability to design and manufacture electrical connections for harsh environments. Whether for automotive, aeronautical, defense, space, medical or industrial applications, or for scientific or petroleum research, Axon' Cable designs tailor-made cables, cable assemblies and miniature connectors. 
Our aim is to offer innovative, custom-designed solutions that add value for our customers and a production tool that can handle both small production and large volumes. 
Axon's strategy is based on a long-term view and a relationship of trust with its partners and employees. 

Headquartered in Montmirail, France (100 km east of Paris), the Group employs more than 2,500 people worldwide. It has more than 20 subsidiaries in Europe, America and Asia.

Name: Severin
Description:
Severin is a German quality brand that has been providing innovative, intuitive, and sustainable household solutions for over 130 years. The mission: Premium for everyone. Severin delivers high-quality products that impress worldwide with their design, functionality, and reliability.

The brand combines technical excellence with modern lifestyle, developing products that not only make everyday life easier but also enrich it. Severin is more than technology. Severin is a brand that moves forward and continuously makes the impossible possible.

With its headquarters in Sundern (Germany), a strong international network, five own sales companies in Europe, and a long-standing presence in Asia, Severin underscores its position as a reliable partner.

Severin not only creates outstanding technology but experiences that last. And has always placed value on dependable quality. On premium products. On excellent service. On sustainability. This does not mean luxury that only a few can afford. It means a lifestyle that is accessible to everyone, excites, and exceeds expectations.

Hello, possibilities!

Name: Novy
Description:
Novy, founded in 1907, is the Belgian specialist in cooker hoods, hobs and designer lighting with gesture control.

Novy's products stand for quality, craftsmanship and innovation. Today, Novy employs more than 300 people and is part of the Middleby Residential Group. The brand has its own branches in France, Germany, the Netherlands, UK and distributors in Switzerland, Austria, Italy, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, Sweden, Norway, Lithuania, Estonia and Israel.

Name: ODU Group
Description:
ODU is one of the world's leading connector manufacturers and provides complete connector system solutions for demanding applications to customers worldwide.
With around 2,800 employees, production and development facilities in Europe, North America and Asia and an international sales network, ODU has a strong global presence.
We combine design, development, manufacturing, and cable assembly under one roof, ensuring high quality, innovation and flexibility.
With expertise in circular connectors, modular connectors, electrical contacts and customized solutions, ODU supports customers across medical technology, military and security technology, industrial electronics, test and measurement and the automotive industry.

Name: IZYX Systems
Description:
La société IZYX SYSTEMS est concepteur et fabricant de produits innovant dans le domaine de sécurité électronique depuis 2009. Notre défi au quotidien : surveiller les évolutions du marché et proposer de nouvelles solutions de sécurité. Dynamique, portée par sa volonté de performance et passion, l'équipe d' IZYX SYSTEMS met son savoir-faire au service de votre satisfaction.

NOTRE MÉTIER
Spécialiste en sécurité électronique et verrouillage électrique.
15 familles produits, pour couvrir l’ensemble de vos besoins en sécurité électronique. Du composant au système, nous vous proposons de multiples solutions pour protéger les biens et les personnes, sécuriser les accès des ERP, des bâtiments industriels et tertiaires, ainsi que des habitats collectifs. Nos produits de sécurité électronique sont adaptés à tous types de lieux tertiaires, résidentiels ou industriels, pour en assurer la protection des biens et des personnes.
85% de nos produits sont conçus, développés et designés par nos équipes. Cette maîtrise globale de la chaîne de production, nous permet une très grande réactivité aux évolutions techniques et normatives.

NOTRE ADN
Une relation client basée sur des rapports humains sincères. 
Pour cela, nos équipes sont prêtes à vous apporter le meilleur d’eux-mêmes. IZYX SYSTEMS c’est l’engagement d’une équipe de femmes et d’hommes qui cherchent à progresser en permanence.

NOTRE DÉMARCHE INNOVATION
La recherche et le développement sont au cœur de notre approche industrielle. Notre département R&D conçoit et développe les produits de demain.
Nos experts assurent la veille technologique et réglementaire pour nos 15 familles produits et leurs adaptations permanentes aux contraintes sécuritaires et normes en vigueur.

Name: Waldmann - Light for better results
Description:
Waldmann – Light for better results

Waldmann luminaires take workplaces in industry, offices and healthcare to a new level. The family-owned company has been designing the light of the future since 1928. Its focus on people consistently leads to ‘Light for better results’.

Waldmann stands for the best possible light in the workplace – with minimal shadows and no glare. Human Centric Lighting also simulates the natural course of daylight. In this way, Waldmann lights specifically promote creativity, concentration and well-being. They also adapt to the lighting needs of different age groups. Optimal illumination effectively prevents falls and accidents, which is not only important in industry and healthcare.

Lighting solutions from Waldmann are also part of comprehensive connectivity concepts that enable workplaces to be digitally optimised – energy-efficient, networked and future-proof. Thanks to high vertical integration ‘made in Germany’, durable components and precise workmanship, the products make an active contribution to conserving resources in companies and the environment. A 20-year guarantee is proof of this.

With 100 years of experience, a strong international presence and a reliable global service offering, Waldmann stands for continuity, reliability and intergenerational thinking. As a family-owned company with a drive for innovation, it sets standards in light quality, connectivity and sustainable performance. Waldmann. Light for better results.

Imprint:
http://www.waldmann.com/imprint

Name: Triathlon Group
Description:
The Triathlon Group is a globally operating and well positioned provider of products and services for efficient battery and energy solutions. Our focus is on the application areas of electromobility and stationary systems. The core business includes the development, production and sale of high-quality, powerful battery and charging technology products for industrial applications. The specialized services bundled in the group as well as its regional structure enable TRIATHLON to be extremely close to its customers and to offer solutions for almost any requirement. The group employs more than 1,000 people and is headquartered in Fürth with central production sites in Glauchau and Freiberg. TRIATHLON is represented internationally with sales and production sites in the USA, UK, Australia and France, among others.

Legal notes: https://www.triathlon-batterien.de/en/copyright-menu/data-privacy

Name: MEMCO by AVIRE
Description:
Since 1971, MEMCO by AVIRE has been synonymous with trust, reliability, and exceptional quality. Renowned in the lift industry for our world-class emergency communication and door protection solutions, keeping passengers safe remains our key priority.

Our ground-breaking solutions include light curtains which enhance safety and reduce door damage, protecting both passengers and lift equipment. The Digital Communication Platform (DCP) enables digital emergency communications with higher resilience and clarity of voice communication, to upgrade existing systems or deploy a fully digital service. By leveraging our in-house R&D department and manufacturing factories, we are able to offer digital and software solutions to facilitate smart elevators and Industrial IoT applications.

MEMCO by AVIRE’s mission is to ensure passenger safety by delivering products that meet and exceed industry standards and provide reliable and trusted technology.

Name: DATA MODUL AG
Description: As a passionate enabler, DATA MODUL AG does everything in its power to turn customers' visions into reality. With a comprehensive understanding of hardware, software and services as a harmonious unit, the focus is on developing customised display solutions that precisely meet the specific needs and objectives of the customer. The outstanding core competence of DATA MODUL AG lies in customising, whereby the company not only provides products, but rather tailor-made solutions with a clear market focus. With over 50 years of experience, DATA MODUL AG represents financial stability, innovative strength and international growth. Its presence at more than 20 locations worldwide and a total area of around 40,000 square metres for production, logistics and administration enables the company to respond flexibly to global challenges.

Name: SafeLine Group
Description:
SafeLine is a Swedish company that manufactures safety accessories for lifts. We have over 350 000 installed lift telephones which makes us the largest independent manufacturer specialising in lift safety products in Europe.

We know that our lives are impacted every day by rapid improvements in technology. Changes are happening quickly, and there is no way of knowing exactly what the future holds – to know where we're going.

With a shifting and complex technical landscape, it's easy to get lost. Lift safety used to be just a physical phone line but is today so much more. This of course means a big change for both you and us. But it also means a great opportunity for us to become more time-efficient – to work smarter instead of harder.

That’s why we’ve taken upon ourselves to guide our customers towards the future of lift safety, to take on the challenges posed by this changing technological landscape – something we like to call the SafeLine journey. A journey you are all invited to take with us.

Let’s get going.

Name: Altrics
Description:
Altrics est un EMS spécialisé dans la production de petites, moyennes et grandes séries de cartes électroniques (PCBa) et produits complets.
ALTRICS réalise 50 millions d'euros de C.A et compte 820 collaborateurs répartis entre le siège social (France), et les sites de production (France, Tunisie et Portugal).
Rattachée à la holding ALLIANCE-ELECTRONICS créée depuis fin 2021 avec l'objectif de devenir un des leaders Européens dans les besoins de production high mix-low volume à forte complexité et grands volumes de cartes électroniques câblées ou produits complets.

Name: TRATO TLV
Description:
TRATO-TLV group designs, manufactures and commercialises for more than 70 years innovative lighting products for the tertiary sector, mass distribution and chain stores, transport, health facilities, and hospital equipment for normal care and OT / ICU resuscitation.

With innovative lighting solutions, TRATO-TLV Group aims to create worlds of sensations, facilitate work and safety while being eco-responsible.

For more information please visit: 

https://trato.fr/en

https://www.tlv.fr/en/

https://trato-tlv.com

Name: Proto-Electronics.com - FR
Description:
Proto-electronics.com is the production platform for your PCBA prototypes!

Proto-electronics.com offers a complete solution to produce very small series of assembled printed circuit boards (from 1 to 50 pieces) in extremely short lead times while guaranteeing a real manufacturing quality within its French workshop close to Strasbourg.

Electronic design engineers get an instant all-inclusive offer, including PCBs’ and electronic components’ purchases, assembly, delivery fees and customer support.

Name: FEIN France
Description:
Fondée en 1867 par Wilhelm Emil Fein, le groupe FEIN fait aujourd'hui partie des leaders sur le marché mondial des outils électroportatifs. Reconnu auprès des distributeurs, artisans et particuliers, FEIN se démarque par ses savoir-faire de spécialiste, sa qualité ainsi que par le professionnalisme de ses collaborateurs.

FEIN France propose des solutions pour les métiers du métal, du bois et des matériaux composites. Nous développons et fabriquons des machines, accessoires et consommables à toute épreuve, dans le but de faciliter le quotidien de nos utilisateurs.

Chez FEIN France nous accordons une place importante au développement des compétences, grâce à une politique de ressources humaines plaçant l’intégration, la formation et l'épanouissement personnel au cœur de nos actions.
