L'entreprise compte plus de 1 460 employés et a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 255 millions d'euros en 2016.

Name: LECO Europe
Description:
In 1936, the Laboratory Equipment Company introduced the first rapid carbon determinator for the American iron and steel industry.  Today, almost 80 years later, LECO is recognized globally as a leader in the development of high-quality analytical instrumentation, mass spectrometers, comprehensive two-dimensional chromatography, metallography & optical equipment as well as consumables.

Headquartered in St. Joseph, Michigan (USA), LECO opened its first international in 1967 with the formation of the Export Division in Germany. LECO has over 25 subsidiaries and international offices worldwide, in countries such as Germany, the United Kingdom, Australia, Sweden, Canada, and Mexico. Additional distributors are authorized by LECO to sell and service our products to the rest of the world.

LECO's global footprint contributes to the company's success: At the state-of-the-art research and development center, teams of engineers work together to create and test ideas that will be incorporated into the next generation of instruments. Rugged manufacturing facilities allow quality to drive production - from stamped metal parts to complex electronic assemblies, most components are produced in-house, allowing strict control over the entire manufacturing and assembly process in accordance with the quality standards of ISO-9001.

Whether it is a diverse array of analytical instrumentation, a new way to look at gas and liquid chromatography, rugged metallography products, or dedicated service support after the sale, LECO stands by a commitment of helping you achieve the right results.

Name: Dantec Dynamics

Dantec Dynamics – Turn Measurements into Knowledge

Name: E+E Elektronik
Description:
E+E Elektronik develops and manufactures sensors and transmitters for humidity, dew point, moisture in oil, CO2, air velocity, mass flow, temperature and pressure. Hand-held meters, humidity calibration systems and calibration services complete the comprehensive product portfolio of the Austrian sensor specialist.  

The main areas of application are HVAC and building technology, industrial measurement technology, the automotive industry, pharmaceutical and food industry, cleanroom technology, meteorology, environmental technology and agricultural engineering.

E+E Elektronik has subsidiaries in China, Germany, France, Italy, Korea, USA and India and is represented by over 60 sales partners worldwide.

As a company with a firm commitment to quality, E+E Elektronik has an established and certified quality management system in accordance with ISO 9001 and IATF 16949. E+E also places great value on environmental protection and is therefore certified in accordance with environmental standard ISO 14001 and has been a partner of the Climate Alliance Austria for many years.
 
E+E Elektronik is accredited as a calibration laboratory according to EN ISO/IEC 17025 with the identification number 0608 by Akkreditierung Austria / Federal Ministry for Digital and Economic Affairs. The services of the accredited laboratory include manufacturer-independent calibrations of measuring instruments for the measurands humidity, dew point, CO2, air velocity, air flow, temperature and pressure.

Furthermore, E+E Elektronik has been appointed by the Federal Office of Metrology and Surveying (BEV) to maintain as designated institute the national standards for humidity, dew point, air velocity and gas concentration CO2 in Austria.

Name: Pickering Electronics
Description:
Pickering Electronics was formed in January 1968, with the aim to design and manufacture high quality reed relays, intended principally for use in Instrumentation and Test Equipment.

Today, Pickering's Single-in-Line (SIL) range is by far the most developed in the relay industry with relays 25% the size of many of their competitors. The small SIL relays are sold in high volumes to large ATE companies throughout the world.

Pickering relays have many advantages over the more usual ‘Hard Moulded’ construction. They are constructed using SoftCenterTM technology which greatly reduces stress on the delicate glass reed switch capsule for maximum life and performance. Mu-metal magnetic screening allows high packing density without the risk of problems due to magnetic interaction between relays.

Pickering Electronics is an ISO 9001 certified company

Description:
Uniross: Smart Energy Solutions Provider for Professionals, Industrials, and Households.

At Uniross, we specialise in delivering cutting-edge batteries that are both innovative and robust, guaranteeing high performance.

Our extensive range of battery solutions encompasses a variety of chemistries, including Lithium, Nickel Metal-Hydride, Nickel-Cadmium, and Alkaline Manganese. These solutions come in diverse sizes, capacities, and voltages, catering to various applications. From military and telecom equipment to connected devices, industrial utilities, portable payment terminals, point-of-sale systems, light mobility solutions, household devices, and beyond, Uniross has the perfect power solution to meet your needs.

In line with our commitment to sustainability, Uniross envisions integrating eco-friendly and post-consumer recycled materials into our manufacturing processes throughout this decade. By doing so, we aim to minimise our products' ecological footprint and reduce their environmental impact.

Join us on our journey to redefine energy solutions and embrace a sustainable future with Uniross.

Name: SEDERE
Description:
At SEDERE, we are dedicated to advancing analytical science through reliable, precise, and innovative detection technologies. As the pioneer and global specialist in Evaporative Light Scattering Detectors (ELSD), we design and manufacture high performance instruments that empower laboratories to achieve accurate and reproducible results across a wide range of applications.

Building on our long-standing expertise, SEDERE has developed LT ELSD technology, a major evolution of traditional ELSD.
This advanced approach delivers significant benefits, including:
•	Enhanced sensitivity, enabling the detection of low concentration analytes with greater confidence
•	Improved baseline stability, providing cleaner, more reliable chromatographic results
•	Lower operating temperatures, ideal for thermally sensitive or semi volatile compounds
•	Exceptional robustness and ease of use, ensuring consistent performance in routine and advanced workflows
•	More uniform response across diverse analytes, making LT ELSD a powerful and versatile solution for modern chromatography

Driven by innovation and backed by decades of know how, our mission is to provide robust, user friendly solutions that meet the evolving challenges of chromatography. We continuously invest in new technologies and product development to deliver next generation instruments combining sensitivity, stability, and operational simplicity.
With a strong and expanding international footprint, SEDERE supports customers and partners across all major regions of the world. Our instruments are distributed and trusted globally, with established representation (Europe, North America, Central and South America, Asia, Oceania, The Middle East and Gulf)
This broad global presence allows us to deliver responsive support, local expertise, and reliable access to our technologies, ensuring that laboratories worldwide benefit from the performance and reliability of SEDERE solutions.

Our activities typically include:

• Supporting projects from idea and technical feasibility to product launch and industrialization
• Providing independent system‐level architecture reviews to challenge assumptions, validate trade‐offs, and reduce technical risk
• Reviewing and guiding electronics and PCB design, including schematics, layout quality, power and signal integrity, EMC, and reliability aspects
• Diagnosing and resolving blocking electronic and EMC issues during validation, certification, or production ramp‐up
• Strengthening internal engineering capability through technical guidance and coaching, sharing best practices and design methods
• Acting as a technical sounding board for founders and leadership teams, helping turn complexity into clear, executable decisions

Creaspin works closely with client engineering teams, suppliers, and manufacturing partners during critical phases such as EVT/DVT, certification, and early production. Our experience spans consumer electronics, medical and diagnostic systems, secure embedded platforms, robotics, and battery‐powered products.

Our approach is pragmatic, hands‐on, and delivery‐driven. We focus on solving real problems, enabling informed decisions, and helping teams bring reliable products to market efficiently and with confidence.

hearth

Notre entreprise propose un service de reprise de lots de panneaux solaires en fin de chantier. Nous sommes intéressés par la reprise de toute quantité et toute puissance de panneaux solaires, et nous nous engageons à effectuer une revalorisation à juste valeur de vos équipements.

Notre processus de reprise est simple et efficace : nous nous rendons sur place pour évaluer les panneaux solaires à reprendre et déterminer leur état. Nous prenons en compte l'âge, l'état de fonctionnement, la puissance, la marque et le modèle des panneaux solaires pour déterminer leur valeur.

Nous proposons une offre de reprise équitable, basée sur la valeur réelle des panneaux solaires. Nous prenons en compte la valeur de revente sur le marché, ainsi que les coûts associés à la dépose et au transport des panneaux solaires. Notre offre de reprise sera donc basée sur ces éléments, afin de garantir une revalorisation à juste valeur de vos équipements.

En optant pour notre service de reprise, vous contribuez également à la préservation de l'environnement en évitant le gaspillage de ressources. Nous nous engageons à donner une seconde vie aux panneaux solaires que nous rachetons, en les réutilisant ou en les recyclant de manière responsable.

Nous espérons que cette proposition répondra à vos besoins et nous restons à votre disposition pour toute question ou demande complémentaire.

Description:

Porté par le développement de l’IoT et des objets connectés, l’électronique s’implante dans tous les secteurs de notre économie : automobile, aéronautique, militaire, mais aussi médical, agricole, textile, bâtiment, industrie,... Cette nouvelle donne crée de nouveaux besoins d’intégration technologique auprès d’acteurs parfois très éloignés de la culture électronique et peu au fait des offres du marché. 

Le salon Enova, plateforme de convergence des technologies de l’électronique, de la mesure, de la vision et de l’optique, fédère ces acteurs de l’industrie et de la recherche à l’affut de solutions innovantes pour leurs projets de développement.

De l’idée au produit fini et à la production en série, en passant par le prototypage, les tests et la mesure, les chercheurs, ingénieurs et techniciens des Bureaux d’études, des départements R&D de l’industrie, des laboratoires publics et privés ,des start-up, trouveront sur Enova toutes les solutions à leurs problématiques. Quelques soient le secteur d’activité dans lequel ils interviennent.

Véritable accélérateur industriel, le salon Enova accompagne les porteurs de projet en mettant à leur disposition tout le savoir-faire technique et scientifique disponible sur le marché, un programme de rendez-vous d’affaires, ainsi qu’un cycle de conférence pour leur permettre de bien appréhender toutes les facettes de leurs besoins, notamment en matière de système embarqué et d’ajout  de connectivité à leurs produits et services.

Nos interventions sont réalisées dans le strict respect du cahier des charges, des délais et du cadre budgétaire convenus. Elles font l’objet de compte-rendu de visites ou d’études techniques adaptées. Attentifs à l’application des normes environnementales notre entreprise est certifiée RGE (Reconnu Garant de l’Environnement).

Réputée dans la profession pour son approche technique et rigoureuse des dossiers, CASTAING a  toujours eu un niveau  d’exigence élevé sur la qualité  de conduite des chantiers, garant de la satisfaction des clients et de la réussite de l’entreprise.

Dyson solves real-world problems and creates better products through the application of engineering, science, design and creativity. It is a family-owned, global technology company, founded by Sir James Dyson who remains at the helm alongside his son Jake. 

Since inventing the first cyclonic bagless vacuum cleaner, the DC01, Dyson has consistently invested in research and development to improve its products and technologies radically. Dyson offers products across a growing range of areas: floorcare, air purification, robotics, haircare including formulations, lighting, hand drying, and most recently audio. Dyson continues to expand into new areas.

Today, Dyson sells products in more than 80 markets, has 450 Dyson stores worldwide and is available in all major technology and beauty retailers. Dyson has global headquarters in Singapore and major technology campuses in Singapore, the UK, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its global team of engineers, scientists and software developers are focused on developing technology-enabled products which work better and which people love to use. Key areas of focus have included high-speed electric digital motors, sensing and vision systems, robotics, machine learning and aerodynamics. 

Beyond products, to encourage an inventive future, Dyson is also inspiring the next generation of engineers and inventors through the Dyson Institute of Engineering and Technology, the James Dyson Foundation and the James Dyson Award.  

The Dyson family applies its problem-solving approach in other fields, and established Dyson Farming in 2012. It is one of the largest farming businesses in the UK, extending to 36,000 acres across Lincolnshire, Oxfordshire, Gloucestershire and Somerset. It is a family-owned enterprise unlike any other, focussed on long-term investment in British farming and the countryside to grow tasty and nutritious food.

Name: Wallbox Chargers
Description:
Wallbox is a global company, dedicated to changing the way the world uses energy in the electric vehicle industry. Wallbox creates smart charging systems that combine innovative technology with outstanding design and manage the communication between vehicle, grid, building and charger.

Wallbox offers a complete portfolio of charging and energy management solutions for residential, semi-public and public use in more than 98 countries.

Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Barcelona, the company now employs over 900 people in its offices in Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

Name: Saft
Description:
Saft specializes in advanced technology battery solutions for industry, from the design and development to the production, customization and service provision. For more than 100 years, Saft’s longer-lasting batteries and systems have provided critical safety applications, back-up power and propulsion for our customers. Our innovative, safe and reliable technology delivers high performance on land, at sea, in the air and in space. Saft is powering industry and smarter cities, while providing critical back-up functionality in remote and harsh environments from the Arctic Circle to the Sahara Desert.

Saft is a wholly owned subsidiary of TotalEnergies, a broad energy company that produces and markets energies on a global scale: oil and biofuels, natural gas and green gases, renewables and electricity.

Name: Exide Group
Description:
Exide Technologies in EMEA & Asia-Pacific is a standalone company. This is the start of an exciting new journey. 

Exide Technologies, headquartered near Paris, France, is a leading provider of advanced energy storage solutions for the automotive and industrial markets. It designs, manufactures and markets today ́s and next-generation battery technologies that are used across a wide range of applications, from automotive and off-road to material handling, stationary, rail and defense. 

Exide Technologies serves the global markets with top notch battery technologies, know-how & added-value services under many well-known brands. As an original equipment manufacturer to leading automotive and industrial equipment manufacturers, Exide Technologies has been involved in many of the big breakthrough energy storage developments that are enabling innovation across the markets. 

Exide Technologies introduced the first Start-Stop AGM and EFB batteries to the market, ushering in an era of start-stop vehicles. It has also introduced next-generation lithium storage solutions, from fast-charging forklift batteries to energy storage in off-grid telecom base stations.

With two R&D facilities and nine production plants in Europe, Exide is committed to high-quality engineering, manufacturing and recycling, and continues to innovate to power the world with the most efficient energy solutions and helping customers maximize productivity and performance

Name: iGuzzini
Description: We are a global design partner dedicated to building the culture of light through innovation, connectivity, and sustainability, providing unique lighting solutions for spaces and people everywhere.

Name: Kempower
Description: We design and manufacture reliable and user-friendly DC fast-charging solutions for electric vehicles. Our vision is to create the world’s most desired EV charging solutions for everyone, everywhere. Our product development and production are based in Finland and in the U.S., with the majority of our materials and components sourced locally. We focus on all areas of e-mobility, from electric cars, trucks, and buses to machines and marine. Our modular and scalable charging systems and world-class software are designed by EV drivers for EV drivers, enabling the best user experience for our customers around the world. Kempower shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd. kempower.com

Name: Salto
Description:
Salto is one of the three core brands that constitute a unique brand platform: @SaltoWecosystem. Salto leads the digital transformation of access and identity management through innovative technologies and solutions. 

Established in 2001, Salto has evolved into a global leader in access control technologies. With a widespread network spanning the globe, Salto places significant value on the creativity and diversity of its talented individuals, who serve as the driving force behind our continued growth. 

Make sure to also follow our other two main core brands: 

Gantner — develops reliable and smart identification, access, cashless payment, and innovative locker solutions. 

Vintia — specializes in ticketing and booking systems that revolutionize the customer experience in the leisure and attractions sector. 

For further information, please check out our website at www.saltosystems.com and our official brand platform at www.saltowecosystem.com.

Name: FOSS
Description:
FOSS is known throughout the world for efficient, analytical solutions that help to improve both food quality and safety in the global food market. And we are playing an increasingly important role in ensuring optimal use of valuable agricultural resources and have created groundbreaking innovations throughout the years in analytical technology. FOSS provides instruments and solutions to the world’s 100 largest food companies and for over sixty years, FOSS has been at the forefront of creating analytical technology.

Did you know that.... 

- 85% of the world’s milk production
- 80% of grain traded on the world market

...is tested using a FOSS solution? 

FOSS employs around 1,700 people working all over the world including almost 800 in Denmark. The analytical instruments are marketed and sold through a global network of sales subsidiaries in over 32 countries and by more than 75 dedicated distributors spread over Europe, North, South and Central America, Africa, Asia, and Australia.

Name: Ohme
Description:
Hey there! We're Ohme. 

We’re on a mission to speed up the global transition to clean energy by providing affordable and easy-to-use smart charging technology for drivers around the world.

At Ohme, we’re focused on engineering smart home chargers that give drivers the power to get the most from their electric vehicle, while saving them money and helping the planet. Our industry-leading tech integrates with all energy tariffs, so that drivers can charge at the cheapest and greenest times available.

Paving the way towards an electric future – one charge at a time. 

Explore opportunities at ohme-ev.com/life-at-ohme/

Name: Radiall
Description:
Radiall was founded in 1952 to make coaxial plugs for the emerging television industry. Today, Radiall is a global manufacturer of interconnect components for numerous industries including aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, railway and telecommunications. Over the years, we have acquired brands such as D-Lightsys, Raydiall, VanSystem, Timbercon and Solyneo to better serve our customers and expand our market reach.

Over the past seven decades, Radiall has pioneered innovative interconnect solutions that reach every corner of the globe, fly in space and are recognized by leading brands for their enduring performance. With cutting-edge manufacturing facilities on three continents and a footprint in 17 countries, we support eight primary industries and hundreds of applications. You’ll find us everywhere technology brings people together, from buses and trains to commercial aircraft and satellites.

Name: Zaptec
Description: We believe that the future is electric and that adventures should be powered more sustainably. By making EV charging accessible for all, we hope to inspire a new generation of explorers with the freedom to go wherever – whenever.

Name: EPIC - EUROPEAN PHOTONICS INDUSTRY CONSORTIUM
Description:
EPIC (European Photonics Industry Consortium) is the world leading industry association dedicated to strengthening the competitiveness of the European photonics sector. The organization supports the entire photonics value chain by exploring markets, expanding applications, and connecting people and companies within the ecosystem.
EPIC’s mission is to drive the growth of photonics technologies through networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across more than 800 member companies.

Description:
PCBWay has specialized in PCB prototype, small and medium batch production. It was founded in 2014, and we are constantly growing.  With over 15 years’ professional experiences and advanced manufacturing capabilities of our factories, in the past 4 years, our products have been well marketed in 150 countries and used by 250,000 clients around the world.

Name: Réseau DEF
Description:
Réseau international et indépendant d’entreprises expertes en sécurité incendie, le Réseau DEF est un acteur majeur sur le marché européen dans le secteur des SSI - Systèmes de Sécurité Incendie.
Fondé en 1958 par Daniel Lécuyer, père de l’actuel président, ce réseau international basé dans 10 pays est composé de plus de 50 entreprises. A travers ses entreprises expertes et complémentaires, le Réseau DEF fournit des produits et services pour des projets de toute complexité. Les expertises rassemblées au sein du Réseau vont bien au-delà de la détection et de l’extinction, en intégrant notamment des solutions de sonorisation, gestion des issues de secours, désenfumage et compartimentage.

•	Plus de 50 entreprises
•	12 usines en France et à l’étranger
•	2 400 collaborateurs
•	130 ingénieurs dédiés à la R&D
•	1958 : date de création


ABOUT THE DEF NETWORK
DEF Network is an international and independent network of fire safety expert companies, and a major player on the European market of the FSS - Fire Safety System. This international network was founded in 1958 by Daniel Lécuyer, father of the current president, and counts more than 50 companies based in 10 countries. Through its expert and complementary companies, DEF Network provides products and services for project of any complexity. Expertise gathered within the DEF Network go far beyond detection and extinguishing systems, and include, among others, voice alarm and public-address solutions, exits management, smoke extraction and compartmentation.

KEY FIGURES
•	more than 50 companies

•	2,400 employees
•	130 R&D engineers
•	1958 - date of foundation

Name: ACOME Group
Description: Technological flagship of the French industry, specialist in high-tech cables in the automotive and data networks markets, ACOME Group is a major player in the industry of cables, optical fibers, microducts and synthesis tubes. With a total revenue of €600 millions in 2025 and close to 1,600 employees in France, Germany, Italy, China, Brazil, Morocco and USA, the Group generates more than 60% of its business internationally.

Name: MVG | Microwave Vision Group
Description:
The Microwave Vision Group offers cutting-edge technologies for the visualization of electromagnetic waves. With advanced test solutions for antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation and electromagnetic measurements, we support company R&D teams in their drive to innovate and boost product development.

Our solutions include:

•	MV-ScanTM technology: electronically-scanned multi-probe arrays
•	Antenna, RCS, radome & EMC measurement systems
•	Turnkey anechoic chambers
•	StarMIMOTM: MIMO testing systems
•	Antennas & probes
•	Wireless device measurement & certification, including SAR & HAC
•	Measurement software
•	RF safety  monitors and other applications 
•	RF absorbers
•	EMC shielded chambers 

With highly skilled teams across the world and over 450 dedicated employees, we proudly serve the telecommunications, aerospace&defence, automotive, academic and research communities.

Over a period of more than 30 years, MVG has unified the skills of four industry leaders (Satimo, Orbit/FR, Rainford EMC, AEMI).

Together, under one unified brand, we tackle some of the world’s most complex electromagnetic wave visualisation challenges.

Name: Instagrid
Description:
Instagrid is redefining portable power, offering innovative, sustainable solutions that meet demanding energy needs – wherever you are. As a B Corp-certified company, we’re committed to not just reducing fuel emissions, but also enabling our customers to work cleaner, safer, and more efficiently. Our products, including Instagrid ONE, Instagrid GO, and Instagrid LINK, provide silent, fume-free, and grid-like power in any setting, eliminating the need for traditional generators. 

Designed with mobility in mind, our battery-based, portable power supplies are lightweight yet robust, allowing professionals in construction, film & media, emergency services, and events to power their work seamlessly. What sets us apart? 

- Single-handed portability: Our power units are lightweight, compact and designed for easy, one-person transport. 

- Unrivaled power: Our unique micro-inverter technology delivers high peak power for the most demanding tools.  

- Sustainable by design: Eliminate fuel costs and carbon emissions with our advanced battery technology, providing reliable, long-lasting power that keeps your operations running efficiently throughout the day. 

- Reliable in extreme conditions: Instagrid products perform in challenging environments, from remote construction sites to high-demand film sets. 

With a growing network of satisfied customers across industries and continents, we’re helping businesses achieve their sustainability goals while powering how work gets done. Join us on this journey to cleaner, smarter energy solutions that don’t compromise on performance or reliability.
⠀
#startups #electricity #power #pure #clean

Name: Fischer Connectors
Description:
Founded in 1954, Fischer Connectors designs, develops and deploys end-to-end interconnect solutions for ecosystems requiring local transfer and management of data, signals and power. Its tailored electronic solutions, connectors and cable assemblies are trusted globally for their reliability in demanding environments.

The company is part of the Swiss-headquartered technology group Conextivity. With 800+ employees worldwide, 1 R&D center located in Switzerland and supported by regional hubs, 3 main manufacturing sites and a network of partners, and 2 business activities (Fischer Connectors and Wearin'), Conextivity Group offers high-performance connectivity solutions that manage power and data flows seamlessly from sensors and devices to the cloud and AI, enabling the emergence of new transverse and scalable ecosystems.

Fischer Connectors’ products and solutions are tested to MIL-SPEC & IEC standards, and compliant with RoHS and REACH. They use the latest technologies in ruggedness, sealing, high-density miniaturization & data transmission for demanding, harsh-environment application fields such as defense & security, medical, robotics, automation, sensors and test & measurement. ISO 13485:2016 certified, Fischer Connectors manufactures quality products that are safe and reliable for integration into medical devices.

Fischer Connectors provides customers with:
- Standard or tailored solutions with dedicated technical support, consulting, system-level engineering, simulation and testing
- High responsiveness, fast prototyping and unrivalled lead times and customer service 
- IP68/IP69 sealing & hermeticity
- Weight optimization, high density, miniaturization
- Signal integrity, high-speed data transmission
- Cable assembly capabilities from design drawings, proofs of concept, prototypes to industrialized solutions
- Dedicated, pioneering electronic development from initial evaluation and proof of concept to design, industrial supply and life cycle management

Name: Ulike Global
Description:
We are Ulike, a beauty-tech group that aspires to make beauty more accessible to women around the world.  

We believe everyone is equal in beauty. Since the beginning of our establishment, we have empowered beauty with technology, made unattainable beauty at your fingertips, and helped more women explore the energy of beauty inwardly. 

We have been doing one thing for 10 years, and that is to bring salon beauty to women. With a presence in 17 countries and regions, we are committed to taking this dedication further and creating more premium at-home beauty devices for women throughout the world.

Name: Optoma
Description:
Experience more.

With customer needs and the user experience at the centre of everything we do, Optoma’s projection, LED and interactive flat panel display products combine superior image processing technologies with exceptional engineering and innovation to deliver stunning crystal clear images with ultimate reliability. 

Designed for professional AV and home entertainment, our award-winning projectors use DLP technology, pioneered by Texas Instruments.

The Optoma Group has continental headquarters in Europe, the USA and Asia Pacific. Optoma Europe, based in London, covers Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA). Local services are delivered from multiple offices across this region.

Name: Kanthal
Description:
Electrification of heating processes is a key enabler for a fossil-free industry. As a world leader in sustainable heating technology, Kanthal collaborates with energy-intensive industries such as steel, cement, petrochemical and battery to develop electric heating solutions that help minimizing their carbon footprint.

Kanthal has provided industry-leading electric heating technology to the world since 1931, when metallurgist Hans von Kantzow founded the company in Hallstahammar, Sweden, based on his discovery of the FeCrAl (iron-chrome-aluminum) alloy.

Over the years we’ve built the largest product range of resistance heating solutions for industrial applications on the market. Our ability to develop and melt specific alloys and convert them into wire, strip, tubes and plates allows us to offer heating materials as well as heating elements and complete heating solutions to our customers.

Today we’re a truly global company with production units and sales offices all around the world.

Take a look at our career opportunities!

Name: SOLUM
Description:
SOLUM is a Global Solution Provider delivering next-generation innovations in retail, energy, electronics, and healthcare.

Since spinning off from Samsung Electro-Mechanics in 2015, SOLUM has leveraged over 50 years of technological expertise to lead in diverse industries with solutions such as Newton Electronic Shelf Labels (ESL), digital signage, power modules, IoT platforms, sustainable energy systems, and smart healthcare devices.

Headquartered in South Korea, SOLUM operates over 20 sales subsidiaries and offices worldwide, including major hubs in the USA, Germany, Japan, and Mexico, with expanding presence across Europe and Asia. We also run 5 global production sites in Dongguan (China), Vinh Phuc (Vietnam), Noida (India), Chula Vista (USA), and Bekasi (Indonesia) — supporting global markets with agile manufacturing and advanced R&D capabilities.

With 566+ global patents and a workforce of which over 60% are R&D specialists, SOLUM connects tomorrow’s technologies with today’s value, creating a sustainable future.

Name: Piller Power Systems
Description:
„Nothing protects quite like Piller“ - with this principle Piller is a world leader in power protection technology and builds electrical systems for mission-critical applications worldwide. 
Clients include many of the world's central and commercial banks, stock exchanges and other financial institutions, as well as broadcasters, airports, telecommunications networks, government departments and co-location operators. 

Founded by the German engineer Anton Piller in 1909, more than a century on Piller is No. 1 in High End Power Protection. Today the company has subsidiaries across Europe, the Americas, Asia and Australia and employs approaching 1000 people worldwide.

Name: IDS Imaging Development Systems GmbH
Description:
Cameras are indispensable in automation. We offer an enormously wide range of hardware and software for industry and numerous other sectors - to make processes more efficient, machines more intelligent, and results even better.

Who we are:

IDS Imaging Development Systems GmbH was founded in 1997 as a two-man company. Since then, we have developed into a global player with about 320 employees and branches in Europe, Asia, and the USA. Our cameras are in use worldwide - across all industries, from medicine and agriculture to ITS, the automotive industry, and scientific institutions.

Our product lines include 2D and 3D cameras with different interfaces and capabilities, as well as an enormously wide selection of image sensors for a wide variety of applications. Additionally, we develop custom cameras and, of course, also provide the appropriate software. With us, you get quality "Made in Germany". All cameras are developed and produced at our headquarters in Obersulm, Germany. We place great emphasis on sustainability - in production as well as in shipping and packaging. Our team aims to provide you with the best user experience in the vision market. That is why we focus on user-friendliness and demand-oriented features.

Name: CATU
Description:
EUROPEAN LEADER IN ELECTRICAL HAZARD PROTECTION AND PREVENTION EQUIPMENT

Created in 1919, CATU firstly developed the manufacturing of equipment for electrical transmission & distribution networks. From the 40's, CATU clearly concentrated on the conception and manufacturing of protection equipment against electrical risks. It focused on developing and perfecting safety equipment for the electricians, for both distribution & transmission, in close relationship with the french national utility EDF. 
The international experience and recognition gained with EDF contributed to giving to CATU, an image of specialist at the world level.
Since 1996, CATU is part of the Groupe SICAME, one of the world leader in production & sale of accessories for electrical networks. In following years, various acquisitions and development have shaped the european leader & world recognized player that CATU is in its sector.

THE WORLD OF ELECTRICAL SAFETY 

CATU constantly invest into its R&D activities. As a permanent member of the main national & international technical committees (such as UTE, CENELEC, CEI, ASTM...) CATU contributes to the development and the application of new technologies, to make work & intervention in electrical installations always safer.

Today's vast range of products includes warning signs, lock-out, earthing & short circuiting systems, voltage detectors & controllers, live line working tools & equipment, insulating rubber gloves, harnesses, arc-flash & other personal protective equipment.

Thanks to an efficient international sales organization and a worldwide red of agents & distributors, safety equipment from CATU and its subsidiaries (FESP, SUPERSAFE, CEGERS, PONTARLIER ELECTRONIQUE...) are used by the main transmission & distribution utilities, high & medium voltage contractors, low & medium voltage installers of the tertiary domain, heavy industries, railroad and automotive sector in more than 100 countries, over the 5 continents.

From Europe - for Europe

Name: TTK
Description:
TTK is a global leader in digital liquid leak detection systems, engineering and manufacturing advanced solutions for over 35 years. Our smart sense cables detect water, hydrocarbons, acids, and the latest liquid cooling fluids used in high-density data centers.

Founded in France in 1989, TTK’s headquarters, R&D center, and manufacturing facilities are based in Paris. Our global presence spans subsidiaries and offices in London, Frankfurt, Philadelphia, Seattle, Los Angeles, Chicago, Ottawa, Dubai, Mumbai, Hong Kong, Singapore, and beyond. All products are made in France, certified by international standards including UL, FM, IEC, and ATEX, and trusted by tens of thousands of clients worldwide.

Our flagship FG-NET system offers real-time leak location accuracy (±1m), full compatibility with all TTK cables, BMS/SCADA integration, and a 7” touchscreen interface—delivering comprehensive protection for data centers, critical facilities, and commercial infrastructure.

As specialized manufacturers, we deliver tailored, reliable solutions—aligned with your project, budget, and timeline.

Name: Citel
Description:
Founded in 1937, CITEL is an industrial group that engineers, manufactures and sells protection solutions for electrical networks, telephone (digital & analog) and mobile equipment, PV systems, Led lighting systems against electrical transients.
These solutions are issued from continuous efforts in research & development, on the component level (such as Gas Discharge Tube), but also on all surge protection ranges to be ahead of our customers needs. CITEL is a worldwide leader in the surge protection market. CITEL has manufacturing facilities in France and in China and has sales office located in France, Germany, USA, China and Eastern Europe.

Name: Vauban Systems
Description:
Founded in 2009, VAUBAN SYSTEMS is a French company specializing in the design and manufacture of comprehensive supervised security solutions for physical access control, video protection and anti-intrusion systems.

Our solutions are available both in client-server mode (via our VISOR supervision software) and in stand-alone mode (VERSO + Web and SOOTouch ranges). Many advanced features are now required for the protection of tertiary and industrial sites of all sizes. We respond to this with a single and unique range of products with no notion of license cost, which has a very economic impact.

We are committed to transmitting our values of innovation, simplicity and service to encourage our customers to become VAUBAN SYSTEMS ambassadors: our network of qualified installers is growing day by day. As an approved professional training center, we provide technical training to all of our partners and qualify some of them (Gold level) to make them prescribers of our technologies to design offices and end users. We also provide all our installers with a completely free hotline.

Our positioning in the security market is resolutely focused on innovation and service allowing end users to manage their security with all the tools at their disposal (client workstations, web, smartphones and tablets). Our team is committed, responsive, available and agile regardless of the business sector to which it responds; we cultivate a sense of service on a daily basis. All our products (hardware and software) are designed, edited and manufactured in France "until the last weld"; they are guaranteed for 5 years and software updates are free.

Our key figures:
+ 10,000 sites equipped worldwide
+ 60 secure doors every day
+ 1 team of experts always at your service

Name: Audio-Technica Distributed Brands Europe
Description:
Established in Japan in 1962, Audio-Technica is dedicated to creating meaningful connections through sound via its microphones, headphones, wireless systems, mixers and turntables. From providing mics for the world’s largest sporting events, to supplying mixers for government buildings across the world, Audio-Technica never stops in its quest to pursue the highest quality sound for all.
 
As part of this pursual, Audio-Technica has collaborated with some of the world’s leading audio companies to create Audio-Technica Distribution, the go-to place for solutions-focused audio equipment. 
 
In Europe, Audio-Technica’s offices are located in France, Germany, the UK, Spain, the Netherlands and Hungary. These offices support the sales, logistics and marketing needs of EMEA and an extensive network of sales partners are supplied from the logistics centers in the Netherlands, the UK and Spain. These offices are all helping to provide one-stop-audio-solutions for EMEA, with an array of audio brands on offer.

Name: Roland Professional A/V
Description:
Roland Pro A/V, a division of the Roland Corporation, is dedicated to providing solutions in support of audio and video professionals demanding excellence in both performance and functionality.

Through the development and support of video and audio products, we endeavor to improve workflow and maximize creative possibilities in a variety of markets.

Markets we serve include: 

Broadcast • Education • Live Production • Theatre • Videography • Visual Performance • House of Worship

Name: ESYLUX
Description:
ESYLUX develops, manufactures and distributes intelligent automation and lighting solutions that ensure better quality of life and energy efficiency in office buildings, educational institutions and health facilities. People's requirements and needs are central to what we do. To meet this standard, we use our experience in electronics and automation for development in areas such as LED-based systems for energy-efficient, biologically effective light. The perspective ranges from the comprehensive automation and lighting of the individual room to networking and integration into building-wide systems. In view of the often complex requirements we encounter in the process, we place particular value on the simple application of our product solutions.

Our customers and partners are wholesalers, installation companies, electrical and lighting planners and architects who trust our 50 years of market experience and the personal specialist advice our experts provide. Furthermore, we meet the highest quality standards in our research, development and production at our German location in Ahrensburg. Our sales organisation is global: ESYLUX operates in collaboration with experienced trading partners and is represented by a lot of subsidiaries in Europe, Asia and Oceania.

Name: ARCURE BLAXTAIR
Description:
Pedestrian detection embedded cameras for industrial vehicles. 

ARCURE is the world leader in video-based pedestrian detection solutions for industrial machinery and vehicles off-road applications. ARCURE design and manufacture Blaxtair.

Blaxtair addresses most companies’ safety issues in industrial contexts such as construction, mining, quarries, logistics, handling, etc. 

Blaxtair detects pedestrians automatically, localizes them precisely and warns the operator instantly.

ARCURE sell Blaxtair directly or through its distribution network in Europe, North and South America.

Name: EVESCO
Description: At EVESCO, we help businesses deploy scalable, fast electric vehicle charging solutions that free them from the constraints of the electric grid through innovative energy storage.

Name: ARIC
Description:
ARIC est un fabricant français d’appareils d’éclairage professionnel depuis 1946. Forts de près de 80 ans d’expertise, nous concevons, développons et fabriquons des solutions d’éclairage performantes, durables et esthétiques, destinées aux professionnels de l’installation, de l’équipement et de la distribution.

 Notre catalogue compte plus de 2 300 références adaptées au Résidentiel individuel et collectif, au Tertiaire et à l’Industrie :
-	Éclairage intérieur fonctionnel et décoratif
-	Éclairage extérieur fonctionnel et décoratif
-	Sources lumineuses et accessoires
-	Solutions LED innovantes adaptées à tous les environnements professionnels

 Nos sites de production et de logistique :
-	Aubervilliers (Seine-Saint-Denis) – Siège social et administratif
-	Le Mesnil-Amelot (Seine-et-Marne) – Centre logistique, SAV, commerce
-	Segré (Maine-et-Loire) – Unité de production

 Engagés dans une démarche de qualité, d’innovation et de durabilité, nous sommes certifiés ISO 9001 depuis 2018 et médaillés d’Argent Ecovadis en 2025. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans tous leurs projets d’éclairage, du conseil technique à la mise en œuvre.

Name: Appareo Aviation
Description:
Appareo Aviation is certified by all the major aviation and manufacturing regulators, and our experienced teams of engineers and manufacturing professionals understand what it takes to create products that adhere to governmental regulations and withstand environmental requirements.

When it comes to the future of avionics, we truly believe the sky’s the limit.

For more than 15 years Appareo has been building a reputation as innovators dedicated to delivering reliable products. As pilots ourselves, we understand what pilots want, and we work hard to ensure our products are easy to use.

Name: Aurightec
Description:
Aurightec is a global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) provider, operating across Asia and Europe, with production sites in Estonia, China and Malaysia. Aurightec specializes in mid-volume, high-complexity manufacturing, for industrial, defense, telecom, transport, and aerospace sectors.

Built on a 50-year legacy, we offer full value chain support, from product inception to product phase-out management, with a fully customer-dedicated expert workforce. Committed to excellence, compliance, and ethical practices, we empower our clients’ businesses with cutting-edge tailored solutions.

For media inquiries or further information, please contact:

contact.europe@aurightec.eu

Name: Cegelec Oil & Gas
Description: Cegelec Oil & Gas is an electrical/electronic manufacturing company based out of 10 AVENUE DU STADE DE FRANCE LA PLAINE ST DENIS, ST DENIS, France.

Name: binder Gruppe
Description:
binder is a family-owned company rooted in traditional values and one of the leading specialists in circular connectors, headquartered in Neckarsulm. Since 1960, binder has been synonymous with the highest quality. The binder group comprises the binder headquarters, nine sales offices, seven production facilities, two system service providers, and an innovation and technology center.

We collaborate with additional distribution partners across six continents and employ approximately 2,000 people worldwide. In addition to Germany, our locations are in China, France, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Austria, Sweden, Switzerland, Singapore, Hungary, and the United States.

What We Do
We manufacture a wide range of industrial connectors as well as panel-mount and cable connectors for automation technology. Our strengths lie in the custom development, design, and automated production of connectors tailored to customer requirements.

Our product range extends from subminiature connectors to multi-pole machine connectors. binder products are used in agricultural machinery, construction equipment, signaling systems, mechanical engineering, medical technology, measurement technology, as well as sensor and automation technology.

What We Stand For
As an owner-managed family business, we uphold traditional values such as integrity, reliability, and loyalty—and treat them with the utmost care.

Our guiding principle is to continuously evolve, consistently make bold strategic decisions, and never forget where our roots lie.

At binder, it’s not just about “numbers, data, and facts.” Rather, passion, commitment, and down-to-earth values are at the heart of everything we do.

Name: CDVI FRANCE
Description:
Creator of electronic access solutions

A French SME with international influence, a manufacturer of solutions for access control and locking systems since 1985, CDVI Group maintains market leadership, innovation and cutting-edge design under the guidance of founder and CEO David Benhammou.

Know-how
Our company has a major advantage in being able to control all product line development phases: from product design to distribution.

Networks
We are present in every continent through our sales offices and our production centers.

Market
Five sectors: Commercial, Industrial, Public buildings, Multi-tenancy buildings and private residences.

Customers
Primary sales force contacts include distributors of electrical equipment and low-voltage products, security companies, computer and telephone network providers and hardware dealers.

Products
We manufacture the world’s largest and most complete range of access control and locking under flagship brands that have upheld the company’s reputation for over twenty-five years.

Commitments
Concerned about the environment, our strategy directs the Group towards a more responsible industry. Our commitments to eco-recognized organizations make our group a major player in our eco-friendly industry.

Name: Gree Products France
Description:
Fondé en 1991, GREE ELECTRIC APPLIANCES INC. OF ZHUHAI est le plus important fabricant de climatiseurs au monde. Avec GREE Products, le l'importateur exclusif en Espagne, Portugal et en France, il regroupe l’intégralité du cycle de vie du produit : R&D, FABRICATION, COMMERCIALISATION et SERVICE.

Cette passion pour la technologie et le pari sur l’innovation constante nous permettent de vendre 1 climatiseur sur 3 dans le monde.

Name: La Patisserie Numerique - The Digital Patisserie
Description:
#QVEMA saison 4 
La Pâtisserie Numérique propose outils et services pour inventer de nouvelles créations sucrées grâce à l’impression 3D et toutes les techniques de fabrication digitale. Nous concevons des imprimantes 3D alimentaires, des outils sur mesure et proposons des formations.

Name: eMotorWerks, Inc
Description: Founded in 2010, and based in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices across Europe, eMotorWerks is a subsidiary of the Enel Group’s advanced energy services global business line Enel X, revolutionizing the electric vehicle (EV) charging market with its JuiceNet-enabled smart grid EV charging solutions. JuiceNet enabled devices, such as the company’s connected, high-power JuiceBox charging stations, maximize charging efficiency and speed while providing EV owners intuitive control and visibility. By shifting when and how much electricity JuiceNet-enabled stations draw from the grid, eMotorWerks helps utilities and grid operators reduce electricity costs, ease grid congestion, and maximize the use of solar and wind power. eMotorWerks grows the EV charging ecosystem by partnering with EVSE and EV manufacturers to provide an extensive cloud platform for grid balancing and optimization for utilities.

Name: QUNDIS GmbH
Description:
QUNDIS GmbH is an innovative, mid-sized company with about 300 employees located in Erfurt, Germany. QUNDIS is a leading supplier of metering devices and readout systems for the consumption-based billing of water and heating costs. Our devices are now in operation in more than 30 countries, where they are installed in over 8 million housing units. Internationally the company has branches in Paris, Istanbul and Milan.

In our smart factory in Erfurt we manufacture heating cost allocators, heat meters and water meters with the label “Made in Germany”. Our customers include metering-service companies, OEM partners and the housing industry. System solutions for remote meter reading made by QUNDIS help to measure energy consumption and ensure responsible use of scarce resources. Our international growth in the coming years will greatly impact on our company's development.

Innovation is an essential part of our corporate philosophy, for which the company received the TOP 100 award as "Innovator of the Year" at the German SME Summit in 2016. Attractive remuneration, safe and modern workplaces and a far-sighted product policy strengthen QUNDIS as an international company. We operate on the basis of flat hierarchies and personal responsibility. We enable all of our employees to develop on the basis of their individual skills and abilities, and create conditions for a wide range of different career steps.

Visit our website and social media channels to find out more about QUNDIS:

www.QUNDIS.com 
http://bit.ly/QUNDIStwitter
http://bit.ly/QUNDISyoutube
http://bit.ly/QUNDISxing

For press inquiries please contact QUNDIS@pio-com.de

Name: DGA S.p.A.
Description:
DGA designs and manufactures high-end lighting fixtures in Florence. We keep nearly every step in-house, from design to production, which gives us the freedom to shape each solution around the project rather than around a catalogue — and to talk directly with the people designing the space, from the first sketches onward.

We've worked on lighting for hotels, private homes, museums, shops and public spaces, and our showrooms in Milan and Paris keep us close to studios across Europe.

For us, light is a design tool: it interprets architecture, brings out materials, and shapes how people experience a space — made in Florence, close to where it's imagined.

Name: Gewiss France
Description:
GEWISS est une entreprise italienne, leader international dans la production de systèmes et composants pour les installations électriques basse tension.
GEWISS accompagne les entreprises et les collectivités dans les secteurs tertiaires, industriels et résidentiels, en leur fournissant des solutions et des systèmes pour la distribution, le cheminement, la sécurité des installations électriques, l’éclairage haute performance et les bornes de recharge pour les infrastructures IRVE.

En novembre 2022, PERFORMANCE IN LIGHTING, leader historique du secteur de l'éclairage, est officiellement entré dans le groupe GEWISS.

Avec plus de 2 200 employés, le groupe se présente aujourd'hui comme un acteur international, avec des sites industriels, des succursales commerciales, des agences et des distributeurs dans plus de 100 pays à travers le monde.

Name: BBC Bircher Smart Access
Description:
BBC Bircher Smart Access, formerly Bircher Reglomat, develops, produces and distributes intelligent sensor solutions for access systems. With people and vehicle flows growing around the world, ever greater demands are being placed on access points. 
Bircher’s solutions meet the increasing needs for safety, hygiene, accessibility and energy efficiency. Not only are Bircher’s sensor solutions characterised by the company’s comprehensive product portfolio and an international manufacturing network, but they also stand out from the crowd thanks to the dedication and teamwork of its approximately 180 employees and their extensive technological expertise. 
For more than 60 years, Bircher has been fulfilling the specific needs of its international clients with an extended distribution network spanning Europe, Asia and North America. BBC Bircher Smart Access has been a business unit of the BBC Group since 1991.

Further information can be found on our website: www.bircher.com

Name: Wieland Electric France
Description:
Wieland Electric GmbH est une PME familiale, spécialisée dans l’industrie électrique et électronique, dont le siège se situe à Bamberg, en Allemagne. La société familiale, très orientée vers l’international, a des filiales dans le monde entier et maintient son statut de leader dans le domaine de la connectique électrique enfichable pour les installations tertiaires et industrielles. En plus de ses lignes de production à Bamberg, il existe aussi des unités de production en République Tchèque et en Chine.
Wieland Holding, à laquelle appartient également STOCKO Contact GmbH & Co. KG depuis 1998, est représentée dans plus de 70 pays, et compte environ 2200 employés.
 
Nous sommes présents en France depuis plus de 30 ans et la filiale Wieland Electric France a été créée en 1990.
23 personnes, dont 12 ingénieurs commerciaux et agents commerciaux sont aujourd’hui prêts à vous apporter des solutions adaptées à vos problématiques depuis son siège de Cergy Pontoise ou en région.
Les spécialistes du tertiaire vous apportent des solutions de distribution d’énergie et d’automatisation décentralisées pour vos bâtiments. Un bureau d’étude vous aide à concevoir vos installations. Cette expertise à fait de nous le leader de la connectique « plug and play » en France.
Les spécialistes de l’industrie vous conseillent et proposent nos solutions de distribution d’énergie, de sécurité machine, et tout ce qui concerne l’automatisation industrielle.
Nous sommes certifiés ISO 9001 et ISO14001.

Name: Jauch Quartz
Description:
Established in 1954, Jauch is one of the leading specialists for quartz crystals and oscillators. As a recognized expert in the field of lithium battery technology, we develop customized lithium battery packs.

We underline our claim to leadership with our in-depth technical consulting, high application, and certification expertise, advanced test environments, high availability and fast delivery of products and the world’s largest warehouse for frequency control products.

We have invested in production facilities at our headquarters in Villingen-Schwenningen to meet customer needs around the world in a timely manner.

A modern batteries assembly line for battery solutions with high technical requirements ensures the production of individual battery packs for medical, home and garden applications, mobile phones, mobile transportation, and the automotive sector.

Name: Dyson France
Description: Chez Dyson, nous partons de la frustration d'utilisateur pour concevoir des appareils qui apportent de vraies solutions à un problème posé. Nos ingénieurs se remettent toujours en question pour améliorer nos technologies et développer de nouvelles inventions.

Name: Eco-Adapt
Description:
Eco-Adapt is a company specialized in energy monitoring and predictive maintenance.
 
« If you cannot measure it, you cannot improve it” – Lord Kelvin. For energy efficiency economic policies or regulations to reach their goals, consumers need to measure precisely and distinctly the benefits of each of their actions. To tackle this challenge, Eco-Adapt offers high-performance and easily deployable hardware and software solutions.
 
Optimizing the maintenance of machines and equipment for tertiary or industrial sites is a major economic and environmental challenge. Eco-Adapt offers solutions to anticipate and predict critical machine failures to reduce maintenance costs and eliminate service disruptions.

Name: BS BATTERY
Description:
Crafting ingenious battery solutions for all 
powersport applications defines the core identity of 
BS BATTERY .
Based in France, founded in 2008, our family-run 
company offers more than 400 battery solutions 
developed by an active Research & Development 
team and 2 stable production facilities. 

Original Equipment Manufacturer approved by major 
motorcycle brands, involved with Racing Teams in 
all categories, BS  BATTERY ’s growth is fueled by 
the active engagement of its loyal partners across 
more than 80 countries supported by 3 subsidiaries and 3 coordination offices around the world.

Service oriented and passionate, BS BATTERY has 
become in just a few years, one of the largest and 
most innovative powersport battery manufacturer, 
becoming a reliable partner of the major distribution 
players and vehicles manufacturers.

Name: Ambiance Lumière France
Description:
Ambiance Lumière, société française, imagine des solutions lumineuses depuis plus de 45 ans.
Nous étudions, concevons et fabriquons des luminaires LED adaptés à vos besoins.
De part son expérience, Ambiance Lumière est force de proposition dans son domaine tant sur le plan national qu'international.

Name: Oxford Lasers
Description:
As one of the most successful spin outs from Oxford University, Oxford Lasers have been at the forefront of laser technology for nearly 50 years.  

The company designs, develops and manufactures the full spectrum of Laser Micromachining Tools & Imaging Systems as well as provide subcontract services for micromachining and imaging applications. 

With a close team of knowledgeable staff, we are also involved in numerous research projects enabling us to keep to the forefront of laser techniques and technologies.

Name: ASD Incendie | Réseau DEF
Description:
ASD Incendie est une entreprise Française, proposant un concept "Direct Usines" pour les professionnels de la sécurité incendie.
ASD est l'entité commerciale des usines de production FARE, SEFI et SESSY appartenant au Réseau DEF. Nous proposons une gamme de produits entièrement personnalisable comprenant des détecteurs automatiques, des matériels centraux, des détecteurs spéciaux ainsi que divers accessoires

Name: Hardware France
Description:
Notre volonté est de mettre en valeur les startups françaises du hardware électronique/numérique et les aider à réussir leurs formidables paris, souvent audacieux et porteurs de ruptures technologiques ou d’usages.

Nos interviews permettent de découvrir celles et ceux qui portent, au quotidien, ces projets, de savoir où ils en sont, quels sont leurs défis, leurs besoins spécifiques, leurs réflexions et propositions pour la politique industrielle de la France.

Nous pensons que, plus que jamais, le secteur du hardware revêt des enjeux majeurs pour la France et qu’il est temps de dynamiser cette industrie, en maximisant les atouts dont nous disposons, ici, en nous organisant et nous structurant.

C’est pourquoi, avec le soutien d’un nombre croissant de startups françaises, nous nous attelons à créer « Hardware France », qui a pour ambition de fédérer le millier d’entreprises françaises du secteur. 

L’objectif de Hardware France sera d’apporter les services dont chaque startup du hardware a besoin, de manière concrète et efficace, grâce à la mutualisation des ressources, des outils, des informations, des expertises et des actions.

Name: Astra
Description:
Innovation in Led Lighting, Manufacturing and exporting led lighting to Europe, Africa and the Middle East.
Astra R&D registered the Double Alfa Heat sink for the use of the new generation of Indium Gallium diodes.
this new HS process is easely adaptable for hot and cool countries.
US Patent pending 13/049,285

Name: IBCONNECT
Description:
At IBCONNECT we have a long-standing history in the design and manufacture of electrical connectivity, voice, data and multimedia systems in order to offer comprehensive solutions that will meet our customers' needs.

We are particularly committed to research and design in order to obtain high-quality products that will provide solutions to the present and future requirements of the world of office furniture and professional installations.

We always start from the same premise: to make it easier for all our collaborators, such as architects, interior designers and installers, to create workspaces that are more comfortable and functional for the end user.

We design and develop comprehensive solutions for a number of sectors:

- Workstations.
- Management offices.
- Meeting rooms.
- Laboratories.
- Universities.
- Schools.
- Libraries.
- Hotels.
- Public authorities.
- Industrial sector.

Name: Audio-Technica France
Description:
Fondé en 1962, Audio-Technica est un consortium mondial voué principalement à la conception, la fabrication, la commercialisation et la distribution d’une large gamme d’équipements audio. Connu au départ pour ses cellules Hi-Fi, A-T fabrique aujourd’hui des microphones professionnels de haute qualité, des casques d’écoute, des systèmes sans fil, des mélangeurs ainsi que des composants électroniques de haute performance pour usages domestiques et professionnels.

Vainqueur de nombreux prix décernés par l’industrie, Audio-Technica axe le développement de ses produits en répondant aux normes de qualité et de fiabilité les plus strictes, tout en conservant le meilleur rapport qualité /prix. Les produits A-T peuvent répondre à tout type d’utilisation, des tournées live aux studios de diffusion et d’enregistrement, en passant par les installations en entreprises ou dans les lieux de culte. Des organismes aussi importants que la Chambre des représentants, le Sénat des Etats-Unis, et le Palais de l’Elysée en France privilégient les microphones A-T. Les microphones et les systèmes sans fil Audio-Technica sont également utilisés pour la diffusion d’événements internationaux tels que les GRAMMY Awards et les intronisations au Rock & Roll Hall of Fame.

Name: @RFID
Description: @RFID is a leading actor in the emerging IOT industry, delivering RFID and contactless solutions and related services to various industries and applications worldwide. With over 10 years’ experience, deep technology know-how and several establishments around the world, @RFID is constantly pursuing the innovation and the perfect customer experience.

Name: AFELIM
Description:
Rassemble en France les entreprises qui exercent une activité dans le domaine de l’électronique imprimée.
• Les laboratoires spécialisés
• Les entreprises de la chimie, de l’électronique, de l’impression et de la plasturgie
• Les fabricants d’afficheurs, de capteurs
• Les entreprises du photovoltaïque, de l’éclairage, de la RFID, du textile,
de l’imagerie, de la signalétique, de l’impression, du médical
• Les institutionnels et pouvoirs publics
• Les établissements d’enseignement supérieur
Pour représenter leurs intérêts et faire émerger une filière performante, créatrice d’emplois.

La naissance de l’électronique imprimée est une véritable révolution:
Le rapport coût/performance de cette nouvelle technologie la rend très attractive pour de multiples applications.
Plus encore, la tendance actuelle d’intégration des composants électroniques dans des objets intelligents
favorise son développement.

> UNE TECHNOLOGIE INNOVANTE:
- Technologie de dépôt similaire à celle de l’impression traditionnelle.
- Production à bas coût, en grande quantité, sur des grandes surfaces (en déroulé ou en feuille à feuille).
- Systèmes électroniques flexibles qui s’intègrent sur tous types de substrats organiques ou non organiques (verre, papier...).

> UNE INDUSTRIE RESPONSABLE:
- Peu de matériau déposé (très faible épaisseur).
- Faible empreinte carbone (fabrication à température et air ambiants dans des salles blanches classe 10 000).
- Pour de multiples applications sur tous marchés (bâtiment, textile, luxe, médical, industrie...)

Name: 3F Filippi | Targetti - France
Description:
Depuis 1928, Targetti conçoit et fabrique des appareils d’éclairage architectural intérieur et extérieur. 
Nous travaillons dans le monde entier et notre objectif est de contribuer à l’obtention d’un résultat optimal pour chaque projet, grâce à nos luminaires.

Chaque jour, nous nous engageons à développer des solutions d’éclairage qui permettent d’améliorer 
l’efficacité et d’optimiser le confort de notre environnement.

Le style Targetti est la capacité d’interpréter la lumière avec intelligence et passion. 
Nous donnons de l’importance à l’innovation et à la recherche mais également à l’émotion unique que la lumière est capable de transmettre.

Chaque produit Targetti exprime les valeurs dans lesquelles l’entreprise se reconnaît. 
D’un côté, le contrôle parfait de la lumière et l’excellence des performances. De l’autre, le soin minutieux apporté aux détails esthétiques.

Nous nous adressons aux concepteurs en leur proposant des solutions flexibles en mesure de satisfaire toutes les exigences en termes d’esthétique et de fonctionnalité, y compris la plus complexe. 

Nous sommes un partenaire de confiance: les compétences et l’expérience acquises, conjuguées à une présence étendue à travers le monde, nous permettent de fournir des réponses rapides et précises.

La collaboration avec des architectes et des concepteurs lumière dans le monde entier donne vie à des projets qui soulignent la flexibilité d’application de nos appareils. 

Des espaces de travail jusqu’au monde de la vente, des espaces de loisirs aux bâtiments historiques et religieux, les produits Targetti s’intègrent discrètement dans chaque contexte architectural. 

En bordure du parc Monceau à Paris, dans un lieu d'exception, le showroom de Targetti France accueille tous les acteurs de la filière éclairage dans une zone d’exposition et d’expérimentation de solutions d’éclairage, où l’accent est particulièrement mis sur "les effets lumière".

Name: Interconnect Solutions Group
Description:
The Interconnect Solutions Group are the global supplier of interconnect solutions with the personal touch. 

250 employees operating across 8 international locations.

The Interconnect Solutions Group delivers industry leading technical support, extensive stock and added value services to customers within the Civil Aviation, Rail, Military, Motorsport, Medical, Space and Energy markets. 

The product portfolio includes high performance Interconnection products, Identification and Protection products, Earth Bonding Leads, Metal Braided products and Aerospace Grade Fasteners.

The Interconnect Solutions Group of companies incorporates Astro Industries, Cabletec, Filcon, Krempfast, LJR, Rayfast and Sommer.

Name: Chauvin Arnoux Energy
Description:
Chauvin Arnoux Energy, expert en intelligence énergétique, est spécialisée en équipements fixes de mesure, de contrôle et de supervision des réseaux électriques et systèmes énergétiques.

Description:
Founded in 1975, Universal Technic develops and produces open frame current transducers whose most known example is the current clamps. Our development department is characterized by its reactivity and its concern for customers’ needs. We always try to adapt the products to suit our clients’ applications. Working with OEM, resellers and final users, we offer a wide range of products (over 3500 references) allowing the measure of current AC and DC from 1mA up to 15000A.
Our products are mainly meant for electrical metrology professionals, when accuracy, sturdiness and repeatability are necessary and even mandatory. They allow the measure of current and power, network quality analysis, leakage current detection, data transmission... The main applications are test & measurement, power quality, energy management and automotive.
